jobs.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

Staff Backend Engineer - Mimir Query, Databases

This is a remote position. We are looking for candidates in the USA time zones.

What is Grafana Cloud?

Grafana Cloud is our composable observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, traces, and profiles with Grafana. It allows our customers to leverage the best open source observability software – including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, Tempo, and Pyroscope – without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack.

The Databases team owns and operates the telemetry databases that are Mimir for metrics, Loki for logs, Tempo for traces, and Pyroscope for profiles. Our databases are offered as a hosted service in Grafana Cloud, and additionally as on-premise solutions with Grafana Enterprise Metrics, Grafana Enterprise Logs, and Grafana Enterprise Traces. They are multi-tenant distributed systems implemented in Go and operating at scale on Kubernetes across all major Cloud service providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).

As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software.

Mimir Squad

The Mimir squad has 3 sub-squads, Ingest, Storage, and Query, which together maintain the Mimir OSS project, and additionally own and operate Grafana Cloud Metrics across 3 major cloud providers. Engineers on the team focus on optimizing the efficiency and resilience of processing, storing, and querying metrics at large volumes. These services operate at a large scale and performance is key to keeping the offering competitive and running smoothly.

A Mimir engineer has various work streams. They are likely engaged in a larger project with another engineer, and they are also incorporating some performance and reliability improvements discovered through operating the system in production. They are also responsible for writing and reviewing PRs and design documents from other engineers in the squad, shepherding automated release rollouts, and participating in the on-call rotation for their systems.

What will you be doing:

  • Take an active role in influencing our roadmap and your own career objectives
  • Work with your team to deliver new features, then use the results to iterate and improve.
  • Drive projects from initial idea all the way to operations once it is in the hands of customers
  • Embrace our open-source culture and contribute to other projects that may not directly fall within your team’s scope
  • Design, build, operate, and maintain critical systems, owning the reliability, performance, and availability
  • Be a part of your team’s follow-the-sun on-call rotations and take ownership of the services you’re running
  • Support other team members, participate in design discussions and collaborate with the team
  • Learn new skills by gaining a deeper understanding of our cloud product and our customers and getting to know the codebase of a large distributed system

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What makes you a great fit:

You are a motivated self starter with a bias towards action. You are customer focused. We build everything with our users in mind. You have a passion for creating intuitive products that fit customers’ needs. You have good time management skills, which you leverage to work on the right things at the right time.

  • Pragmatism: You are able to take on complex challenges and break them down to achieve short feedback loops: to analyze, design, and build modular solutions, deliver MVPs, gather data and feedback and then progress iteratively
  • Collaboration and communication: The smallest unit we have is a squad. You’ll be working with your teammates in a fully remote setup. Good communication and time management skills are a must.
  • Solid experience with at least one programming language. We use Go, but if you have familiarity with Python, C, C++, Rust or similar then that translates well
  • Experience with leading and delivering projects from gathering requirements, brainstorming ideas all the way to shipping a product to the customer’s hands in a self-driven and collaborative way
  • Experience with developing software that runs in the Cloud or experience with systems engineering
  • Experience with being on-call and following the DevOps model
  • Experience writing clean, robust, and performant software that is easily maintained by others
  • Familiarity with observability systems, know when to use metrics, logs, traces, to debug a problem.
  • Comfortable with microservices architecture and distributed systems
  • Experience and comfort developing with LLMs like Claude and Codex on your day to day

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience working with Kubernetes
  • Experience working with queue systems, e.g. the Kafka protocol
  • Been a user of Grafana and Prometheus in operational roles (including on-call for your team at a previous employer or just using these tools on hobby/homelab projects)
  • Familiarity with the concept of infrastructure as code

Compensation & Rewards:

In the United States, the Base compensation range for this role is USD 174,986 - USD 209,983. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed here.

*Compensation ranges are country-specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

jobs.title: Director of Financial Systems
jobs.excerpt: It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

  • Job Description Summary

    This role owns the financial systems landscape the accounting organization runs on, and leads the design, implementation and continuous improvement of those systems. The Director, Financial Systems is accountable for NetSuite, Concur, Celigo, Solution 7 and the financial components of Workday, for the integrity of financial data moving between those platforms and the general ledger, and for the control environment over financial systems. The role serves as project manager for all system-related initiatives across Accounting, is the accounting owner of the AS400 conversion, and leads the company's outside implementation and support consultants. Reporting to the Vice President, Accounting, the Director partners across Accounting, Information Technology, FP&A and the business to deliver systems, automation and process improvement that reduce manual effort, cycle time and risk across the accounting organization. The Director also owns the accounts payable process the role designed and automated, and leads the accounts payable team.

  • Job Description

    Duties and Responsibilities

    • Own the financial systems landscape for Accounting, including NetSuite, Concur, Celigo, Solution 7 and the financial components of Workday, together with the integrations connecting them to operational platforms and the general ledger.

    • Serve as project manager for all system-related initiatives across Accounting, covering intake and prioritization, scoping, business case, resourcing, schedule, budget, status reporting, risk and issue management, and post-implementation review.

    • Serve as the accounting owner of the AS400 conversion, including requirements definition, data mapping and validation, cutover planning, parallel testing, validation of converted balances and post-conversion stabilization.

    • Direct the company's offshore financial systems support capacity, currently CW Global Partners on an hourly as-needed basis and Vincent Cloud under an annual support agreement, covering scope and statements of work, service levels, budget, deliverable quality and escalation.

    • Lead financial system implementations, upgrades and integrations end to end: requirements, configuration, user acceptance testing, training, cutover and hypercare.

    • Design and build automation that reduces manual effort and cycle time in the close, including automated reconciliations, allocations, recurring entries and management reporting.

    • Own the accounts payable process end to end, including the automated workflow the role designed and implemented, exception handling, vendor master governance, and continuous improvement of throughput and accuracy.

    • Lead the accounts payable team, including performance management, development, workload prioritization and coverage planning.

    • Maintain segregation of duties over disbursements: this role owns accounts payable process, systems and workflow design and supervises accounts payable operations, but does not approve payment runs, which remain the responsibility of Treasury.

    • Partner with the corporate and international accounting teams to drive process improvement: map current-state processes, identify manual workarounds and control gaps, redesign the process, and deliver the system or automation change that supports it.

    • Establish and track measures of process performance, including cycle time, manual touch points and error rates, and report progress to the Vice President, Accounting.

    • Identify and eliminate low-value manual accounting effort, including recurring entries and schedules maintained below the company's materiality thresholds, and align system-driven processes with accounting policy.

    • Own the integrity of financial data flowing between operational platforms and the general ledger, including interface design, exception monitoring and validation of system-generated activity.

    • Design, document and operate the control environment over financial systems, including segregation of duties, change management and interface controls; support SOX readiness for IT general controls.

    • Review SOC 1 and SOC 2 reports for financial system vendors and service providers; evaluate complementary user entity controls, track exceptions and confirm remediation.

    • Own periodic user access reviews across financial systems, including provisioning and de-provisioning standards, certification, exception follow-up and retention of evidence for audit.

    • Own financial reporting delivery in Solution 7 and NetSuite, including report design, maintenance and the reporting calendar supporting Accounting, FP&A and executive leadership.

    • Partner with Information Technology and Information Security on system risk, data residency, access and vendor risk requirements for financial applications.

    • Own the financial systems technology and support budget, currently approximately $543,000 annually, of which roughly $493,000 is software and licence contracts across Oracle/NetSuite, Celigo, Concur and Solution 7, and the balance is offshore support; accountable for vendor selection, contracting, renewal negotiation, spend management and evaluation of new financial applications.

    • Document processes, system configurations and controls; maintain audit-ready evidence for internal and external audit.

    • Prepare analysis and written commentary supporting the Audit and Risk Committee reporting cycle on systems, automation and controls matters.

    • Provide day-to-day guidance to the accounting organization on system use; lead training, adoption and change management.

    Minimum Qualifications

    • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems or a related field.

    • 10-15 years of progressive accounting and financial systems experience.

    • Demonstrated experience implementing or converting financial systems with accountability for delivery, covering the full lifecycle from requirements through cutover and stabilization.

    • Experience serving as the business owner, not solely the technical owner, on at least one ERP implementation or major system conversion.

    • Demonstrated project management experience running concurrent system initiatives, including scope, schedule, budget and executive stakeholder reporting; PMP or equivalent certification preferred.

    • Experience directing offshore or outsourced technical support capacity to scope, service level and budget.

    • Experience owning a software and services budget of comparable scale, including contract negotiation, renewal and vendor performance management.

    • Advanced NetSuite experience required, including saved searches, reporting and workflow configuration; Concur, Celigo, Solution 7 and Workday financial modules preferred.

    • Experience with legacy platform migrations (AS400 / IBM i or comparable) preferred.

    • Experience designing and operating IT general controls, segregation of duties and user access reviews in a financial systems environment.

    • Experience reviewing SOC 1 and SOC 2 reports and evaluating complementary user entity controls.

    • Strong working knowledge of the accounting processes these systems support: close, reconciliations, revenue, billing, accounts payable and cash.

    • Demonstrated process improvement experience, including current-state assessment, redesign and measurable reduction in manual effort or cycle time.

    • Experience owning accounts payable operations in a highly automated environment, including workflow design, exception management and vendor master governance.

    • Experience leading, developing and managing the performance of staff.

    • Advanced Excel and data analysis skills; SQL or reporting tool experience preferred.

    • Strong written and verbal communication with both executive and technical audiences.

    Working conditions

    This job operates in a professional office environment or remotely. This role routinely uses general office equipment.

    Physical requirements

    • Ability to communicate clearly and exchange accurate information constantly.

    • Constantly operates computer, keyboard, phone and other general office equipment.

    • Ability to occasionally move objects up to 10 lbs.

    Direct reports

    Lead Accounts Payable Specialist. This role also directs the company's offshore financial systems support capacity, currently CW Global Partners and Vincent Cloud. Transition of the accounts payable reporting line may be staggered.

  • interessante, anspruchsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben in einem qualifizierten und dynamischen Team
  • die Möglichkeit zu flexibler Zeiteinteilung und eigenständigem Arbeiten
  • ein modernes, kollegiales und digitales Arbeitsumfeld
  • Raum für Kreativität und Deine persönliche Weiterentwicklung

Die Vernetzung von Maschinen untereinander und zu steuernden Systemen ist eine zentrale Aufgabe auf dem Weg zu Industrie 4.0. Die reibungslose Kommunikation ist jedoch eine Herausforderung, da Schnittstellen unzureichend standardisiert sind und die Interoperabilität nicht gegeben ist. Eine Lösung können Asset Administration Shells (AAS) sein, die eine digitale Repräsentation von Maschinen darstellen und somit die Vernetzung stark erleichtern. In deiner Abschlussarbeit wirst du anhand einer realen Produktion die Schnittstellen typisieren und auf dieser Basis systematisch eine AAS entwickeln. Diese Forschung ist von fundamentaler Bedeutung für die erfolgreiche Digitalisierung der produzierenden Industrie.

As an Outbound SDR, you will be responsible for generating high-quality pipeline within larger MSP accounts. This is not a high-volume dialing role — it’s a strategic, research-driven outbound position focused on penetrating complex MSP organizations. You’ll partner closely with Senior and Strategic Account Executives to break into named accounts, multi-thread across technical and executive stakeholders, and create meaningful sales opportunities. If you enjoy thoughtful prospecting, personalization, and working alongside senior sellers to win complex accounts — this role is for you.

What will I be doing?

You’ll be part of our growing MSP sales motion, working remotely and collaborating directly with senior AEs and sales leadership.

You will:

  • Partner with Senior & Strategic AEs to develop outbound strategies for named MSP accounts
  • Research target MSPs (size, growth trajectory, service maturity, tech stack)

  • Craft tailored messaging aligned to MSP pain points (network visibility, alert fatigue, scalability, tool consolidation)
  • Book qualified meetings aligned to ICP and territory strategy

What are we looking for?

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • High level of personalization in outreach
  • Comfortable working alongside senior sellers
  • Operates with ownership, urgency, and strategic thinking
  • Thrives in a performance-driven environment
  • Track record of generating qualified pipeline

Bonus Points

  • Experience selling into MSPs
  • Experience with network monitoring or IT tools
  • Familiarity with MEDDPICC-style qualification frameworks

We’re actively hiring for this role and looking to bring someone great onto the team as soon as possible.

About Auvik

Auvik delivers cloud-based network management software that gives IT teams instant visibility and control over their infrastructure — whether on-site, remote, or dispersed across global networks. Our platform automates network discovery, mapping, monitoring, configuration backups, traffic analysis and alerting, so IT professionals and MSPs can manage complex, multi-site environments with ease.

We’re focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re excited about this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. We are happy to make any accommodations you may need throughout the interview process as well.

Auvik is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law.

Hiring Process

At Auvik, our hiring process is designed to be personal, transparent, and human-led. Our Talent Acquisition Partners review all resumes, connect with candidates whose skills and experience aligns with the role, and stay in communication with you throughout your journey. If our interests align, you'll meet with a hiring manager, as well as additional members of the hiring team in follow-up conversations. All of your interviews will take place via Zoom.

We debrief and consider the full context of every conversation before making hiring decisions. We believe hiring requires judgment that can be augmented but, not replaced by AI.

Compensation Details

jobs.description:
Clearance

Public Trust

Overview

Ardent Eagle Solutions (AES) is seeking experienced Senior Records Managers to support a competitive federal contracting opportunity with the U.S. Department of Commerce (DOC), Economic Development Administration (EDA).

The Senior Records Manager will play a key role in assessing, redesigning, and strengthening EDA's Records Management Program to establish standardized, sustainable records and information management practices across EDA Headquarters and six regional offices.

This position will provide senior-level records management expertise with particular emphasis on digital and electronic records, records inventories and disposition, National Archives and Records Administration (NARA) requirements, process standardization, and the development of practical policies, procedures, tools, and training resources.

Background

EDA administers economic development programs and grants designed to support economic opportunities and strengthen economically distressed communities throughout the United States. Its Office of Financial and Management Services (OFMS) is responsible for planning, executing, analyzing, and strengthening EDA's records and information management functions.

EDA is undertaking an initiative to assess and modernize its Records Management Program, including records practices at Headquarters and six regional offices. The effort will address records inventories, retention and disposition, digital and email records, electronic repositories, process documentation, training, and long-term program sustainment.

Responsibilities

The Senior Records Manager is expected to:

  • Lead and facilitate the assessment, redesign, and strengthening of EDA's Records Management Program.
  • Assess existing records management practices across EDA Headquarters and regional offices and identify opportunities for standardization and improvement.
  • Review records policies, file plans, retention schedules, disposition processes, digital and electronic records practices, email and electronic message practices, and related administrative processes.
  • Plan and conduct records inventories, audits, and reconciliations, including identification of records series, owners, formats, locations, restrictions, volumes, and applicable schedules.
  • Develop recommendations and procedures for the transfer, destruction, retention, and disposition of records under Government direction.
  • Develop standardized controls for born-digital records, digitized analog records, email, electronic messages, shared drives, SharePoint, and other electronic repositories.
  • Evaluate records management practices against applicable NARA Electronic Records Management lifecycle expectations and EDA operational requirements.
  • Develop a future-state Records Management Program framework, including governance, roles, processes, repository guidance, disposition workflows, and sustainment recommendations.
  • Develop and/or oversee the development of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), desk guides, checklists, leadership guidance, training materials, and other practical resources.
  • Coordinate with Government stakeholders across Headquarters and regional offices to understand current practices, operational requirements, and records management needs.
  • Support project planning, workplans, risk and issue tracking, recurring status meetings, progress reporting, and transition activities.
  • Provide senior-level subject matter expertise and recommendations regarding NARA records retention policies, schedules, systems, and records management best practices.
  • Support knowledge transfer and transition activities designed to enable long-term Government ownership and sustainment of the program.

Qualifications

Approximately 6 or more years of progressively responsible experience in records management, information governance, federal records administration, or a closely related field.

  • Advanced knowledge and practical experience with NARA records retention policies, records schedules, and records management systems, as specifically identified for the Senior role in the PWS.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting records management program assessments, records inventories, audits, or disposition activities.
  • Experience developing or implementing records management policies, SOPs, file plans, desk guides, checklists, or similar program documentation.
  • Experience managing digital and electronic records, including email, electronic messages, shared repositories, or similar electronic information environments.
  • Ability to analyze existing processes, identify compliance or operational gaps, and develop practical future-state recommendations.
  • Strong written communication skills with experience developing formal reports, procedures, guidance, or executive-level materials.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills and the ability to work effectively with personnel across multiple organizational levels and geographically dispersed offices.

Education

Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

Location and Work Hours

This position is expected to be primarily remote and may be performed from locations throughout the United States, subject to final contract requirements and Government approval.

The position will support EDA Headquarters in Washington, D.C., as well as regional operations in Philadelphia, Atlanta, Chicago, Austin, Denver, and Seattle. The PWS states that work is expected to be performed primarily remotely, with onsite support at EDA Headquarters or regional offices when authorized.

Normal work hours are expected to be Monday through Friday during standard business hours, excluding Federal holidays and Government-directed closures. Final schedules may be adjusted to align with supported EDA personnel and mission requirements.

Approximately 10% travel is anticipated based on current planning assumptions. Travel may include authorized visits to EDA Headquarters or regional offices for meetings, assessments, inventories, training, or other official program activities.

Compensation

Anticipated Salary Range: $125,000-135,000 annually

This position is being recruited in support of a competitive federal contracting opportunity, and AES is continuing to develop its staffing, labor category, and compensation strategy. Because the position is expected to support a primarily remote workforce and qualified candidates may reside in different geographic markets throughout the United States, actual compensation may vary significantly based on location, experience, education, specialized records management expertise, applicable labor category requirements, and other business and contractual considerations.

AES welcomes open and collaborative compensation discussions with interested candidates as we evaluate current market conditions and develop an accurate and competitive compensation strategy for this opportunity. The range above represents our current anticipated range and is not intended to guarantee a specific salary or compensation level.

Benefits and EEO

At Ardent Eagle Solutions, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to our employees and their families:

  • Medical/Dental/Vision Coverage
  • Matching 401(k) Plan
  • Continuing Education Assistance
  • Paid Time Off

This job description is intended to describe the general scope of work and level of work that is needed to perform while on task with Ardent Eagle Solutions. Other duties may be assigned. Selected candidates may undergo a government security investigation and must fulfill eligibility criteria for accessing classified information. US citizenship may be a prerequisite for certain roles.

Ardent Eagle Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to disability or protected veteran status.

  • Proven track record as a finance business partner to Sales, Marketing, or Customer Success organizations

  • Hands-on experience owning commissions modeling and/or variable compensation plan design

  • Proficiency with CRM reporting (Salesforce) and comfort working with large datasets; SQL experience a bonus

  • Familiarity with AI-driven automation tools and a desire to apply them to finance workflows

    • Domain Knowledge

  • Deep fluency in SaaS business metrics: ARR, ACV, NRR, CAC, churn, LTV, pipeline velocity, sales capacity

  • Strong understanding of incentive compensation mechanics and commission plan design

  • Knowledge of quota-setting frameworks, sales productivity benchmarks, and GTM efficiency ratios

    • Soft Skills

  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to operate independently in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment

  • Collaborative partner who earns trust across Sales, RevOps, HR, and the broader Finance team

  • Intellectual curiosity and a bias toward continuous improvement

    • Bonus Points

  • Direct experience using CaptivateIQ or similar incentive compensation platforms

  • Prior experience at a company that went through a hyper-growth phase or public market preparation

  • MBA or advanced degree in Finance, Business, or a related field

Benefits

Notice for Prospective Candidates

  • Only emails from @captivateiq.com should be trusted.

jobs.excerpt: Who we are About StripeStripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses.
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe’s Ecosystem Partnerships team builds the partner ecosystem that helps users discover, adopt, and get more value from Stripe. We work with a broad range of technology, platform, and ecosystem partners, and collaborate closely with Partner Engineering, Product Marketing, Product, Engineering, and Go-to-Market teams to bring Stripe’s products to market through partners.

What you’ll do

As a Partner Development Manager (PDM), you will help manage and grow a long tail of partners that make up the Stripe ecosystem. You will create and manage the programs, partner tiers, operating rhythms, and enablement needed to support partners at scale - not simply one relationship at a time.

You will help partners understand and adopt new Stripe primitives, product capabilities, and integration opportunities. You will turn partner feedback and market context into clear priorities, coordinate cross-functional work, and ensure that partner programs are effective, measurable, and easy to engage with.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys building scalable programs, bringing structure to ambiguous work, and enabling many partners to succeed.

Responsibilities

  • Manage a broad portfolio of ecosystem partners through scalable programs, tiers, communications, and operating mechanisms.
  • Help design, launch, and operate partner programs that provide clear value to partners and advance Stripe’s ecosystem and product priorities.
  • Create and maintain partner tiering, engagement models, program criteria, and lifecycle motions that make it easier to prioritize support and scale partner impact.
  • Drive adoption of new Stripe primitives, product capabilities, and partner-facing initiatives across the ecosystem. Develop partner enablement plans and track adoption, engagement, and delivery against defined KPIs.
  • Work closely with Partner Engineering to surface partner integration needs, identify recurring technical or product friction, coordinate enablement, and improve the partner integration experience.
  • Work closely with Product Marketing to develop partner messaging, launches, education, and campaigns that help partners understand Stripe’s value proposition and take action.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Go-to-Market, Operations, PE&O, RPS, and other stakeholders to translate partner insights into clear workstreams, resolve blockers, and execute effectively.
  • Track partner health, program performance, commitments, and delivery milestones. Use data and qualitative feedback to identify opportunities to improve program design, partner experience, and business impact.
  • Support templated deals, renewals, and other well-defined commercial workstreams using established strategies and processes; escalate material changes, risks, and blockers through the appropriate operating model.
  • Develop a strong understanding of the ecosystem, partner objectives and constraints, Stripe’s product capabilities, and relevant market developments. Share material insights and recommendations with internal stakeholders.
  • Build productive relationships across Stripe and with partners, communicate clearly, and help align stakeholders with competing priorities around shared outcomes.
  • Contribute to an inclusive, high-performing team culture and apply Stripe’s operating principles in day-to-day work.

Who you are

You are a thoughtful, execution-oriented partnerships professional who is energized by operating at scale. You enjoy building programs, defining tiers and operating models, and improving the systems that enable many partners to succeed. You can build context quickly, turn it into clear plans, and collaborate well across functions with different goals and perspectives.

You are equally comfortable engaging partners directly and identifying patterns across a portfolio. You exercise sound judgment within established frameworks, communicate proactively, and know when to seek input or escalate.

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, account management, strategic programs, go-to-market, or a comparable cross-functional role involving external stakeholders.
  • Experience designing, operating, or improving scalable programs, partner tiers, lifecycle motions, or other systems that serve a broad portfolio of customers or partners.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams, establish clear plans and milestones, and reliably deliver on commitments.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and a demonstrated ability to build alignment with stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Operations, Go-to-Market, and/or comparable functions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain product value, synthesize feedback, and keep internal and external stakeholders informed of material developments.
  • Analytical and operational rigor: comfort defining and tracking KPIs, assessing program and partner health, identifying risks or blockers, and using data and structured judgment to improve outcomes.
  • Ability to develop productive relationships with external partners and to balance partner needs with Stripe’s priorities and constraints.
  • Interest in Stripe’s products, our users, and the ecosystem in which we operate.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with ecosystem, platform, technology, payments, financial-services, or SaaS partnerships.
  • Experience driving adoption of new product capabilities, integrations, or platform primitives through partner enablement, education, or go-to-market programs.
  • Experience working closely with partner-facing engineering, product, or product-marketing teams.
  • Familiarity with partner integrations, commercial agreements, partner operations, or risk and compliance considerations in a regulated or complex environment.

jobs.description:
**PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH **

Location: Remote – Latin America
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time
Compensation:$2,500–$3,500 USD/month
Experience:4–6+ years
Schedule: Full-Time | Strong overlap with U.S. Eastern Time required
Industry: Investment Management / Alternative Investments
Department: Go-To-Market / Growth

About the Company

Our client is a fast-growing U.S.-based investment management firm building institutional-quality alternative investment solutions for sophisticated investors, financial advisory firms, and multi-family offices.

The firm combines deep investment expertise with a technology-driven approach and is entering its next stage of growth. As its investment platform and partnerships expand, the company is building a scalable go-to-market engine to generate demand, strengthen its market presence, and support continued growth.

About the Role

We are looking for an Agentic GTM Lead who combines real engineering ability, commercial instinct, demand-generation experience, and financial market knowledge.

This is not a traditional marketing role, and it is not a pure engineering role.

You will build and own the systems that generate demand across outbound, content, social, SEO/GEO, email, and AI-powered automation. You will connect the technical infrastructure behind these channels with measurable commercial outcomes such as qualified interest, booked meetings, and pipeline.

Most importantly, you bring the ideas.

You will not be handed a complete GTM playbook to execute. You are expected to identify new demand-generation opportunities, launch multiple experiments simultaneously, measure what works, quickly eliminate what does not, and scale the strategies that produce results.

This is a highly autonomous, hands-on builder role for someone who enjoys moving from an idea to a working system and then proving its commercial impact with data.

Why This Opportunity?

This role offers the opportunity to build a sophisticated GTM engine from the ground up within a growing investment management business.

You will have significant ownership over how demand is created, measured, automated, and scaled.

You will be able to:

  • Build rather than simply manage existing marketing systems

  • Experiment across multiple acquisition channels

  • Apply AI and agentic workflows to real commercial problems

  • Connect engineering directly to pipeline and revenue

  • Develop systems that automate repetitive GTM work

  • Shape the company's content, social, outbound, and digital presence

  • Work with sophisticated financial products and audiences

What You'll Do

Build and Scale the GTM Engine

  • Develop new demand-generation ideas, channels, and experiments

  • Build systems across outbound, content, social, SEO/GEO, email, and website acquisition

  • Turn successful experiments into repeatable and scalable growth systems

  • Rapidly stop or redesign initiatives that are not producing measurable results

  • Connect GTM infrastructure directly to qualified interest, meetings, pipeline, and revenue

Build Technical GTM Infrastructure

  • Work hands-on with APIs, SQL, Python and/or JavaScript

  • Build integrations between data sources, automation platforms, CRMs, and GTM systems

  • Create workflows using tools such as Clay, n8n, Zapier, and CRM platforms

  • Design lead enrichment, account scoring, personalization, sequencing, routing, and attribution systems

  • Build solutions rather than relying exclusively on no-code configuration

Build AI & Agentic Workflows

  • Design and deploy workflows using LLMs and AI agents

  • Automate research, content development, personalization, lead enrichment, and routing

  • Identify repetitive GTM processes that can be automated or augmented with AI

  • Build scalable systems that allow a small team to operate with significantly greater leverage

Own Demand Generation

  • Build and optimize outbound programs based on signals, data, and a clearly defined ICP

  • Develop demand through outbound, SEO/GEO, content, social, and other acquisition channels

  • Build measurable programs that generate qualified interest and booked meetings

  • Continuously test messaging, audiences, channels, landing pages, and sequences

Build the Content & Social Engine

  • Develop systems for producing and distributing podcasts, videos, webinars, social content, and thought leadership

  • Repurpose long-form content into multiple channel-specific assets

  • Build consistent visibility across platforms such as LinkedIn and X/Twitter

  • Help establish a credible voice for a sophisticated investment and wealth-management audience

Experiment & Measure

  • Run multiple experiments simultaneously rather than testing one channel at a time

  • Conduct structured A/B testing across messaging, channels, landing pages, and sequences

  • Build dashboards for demand generation, attribution, and pipeline contribution

  • Use evidence and commercial results to determine what gets scaled, changed, or eliminated

Required Qualifications

  • 4–6+ years of relevant experience across growth engineering, GTM engineering, demand generation, growth marketing, or related roles

  • Proven ability to generate original demand-generation ideas and independently turn them into experiments

  • Demonstrated demand-generation results through outbound, content, SEO/GEO, social, or similar channels

  • Ability to provide specific metrics or examples showing how your work generated leads, booked meetings, pipeline, or revenue

  • Strong hands-on engineering ability with APIs and SQL

  • Proficiency with at least one scripting language, preferably Python or JavaScript

  • Experience with automation platforms such as Clay, n8n, Zapier, or similar tools

  • Hands-on experience working with CRM systems, integrations, data, and automation

  • Practical experience building with LLMs and AI/agent workflows

  • Strong commercial instinct and ability to connect technical builds to measurable business outcomes

  • Professional experience or strong working knowledge of finance, investing, asset management, or investment management

  • Strong experimentation and A/B testing mindset

  • Ability to build and own initiatives from 0 to 1

  • Strong design and UX judgment

  • Ability to work autonomously in a fast-moving environment

  • Strong overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct professional experience in asset management or investment management

  • Experience with alternative investments and/or hedge funds

  • Strong personal or professional interest in financial markets and investing

  • Experience building a GTM, growth, or demand-generation function from scratch

  • Experience with data warehouses or analytics infrastructure such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or dbt

  • Experience with attribution modeling

  • CFA, MBA, or other relevant finance/business education is a plus

How Success Is Measured

Success in this role will be based on your ability to create a measurable and scalable demand engine.

Key outcomes include:

  • A growing stream of qualified interest and booked meetings attributable to your GTM systems

  • Successful demand-generation experiments that can be scaled into repeatable programs

  • AI-powered and signal-based outbound systems actively generating opportunities

  • Consistent content and social distribution with measurable audience growth

  • Reliable measurement of demand and pipeline contribution

  • A continuous experimentation system that clearly identifies what should be scaled and what should be stopped

  • Existing GTM activities transformed into more automated, repeatable, and efficient systems

Why Join Us

You will join an environment where ideas are evaluated on merit, experimentation is encouraged, and ownership matters.

You will have the autonomy to determine how to reach the goal while being accountable for measurable outcomes.

This role is ideal for someone who prefers building, shipping, measuring, and improving over spending months developing theoretical strategies.

If you are equally comfortable discussing APIs, AI agents, pipeline generation, A/B testing, and investment markets, this role offers the opportunity to bring those skills together in one highly impactful position.

Important Notes

  • This is a remote/telecommute position.

  • Candidates must be able to maintain strong overlap with U.S. Eastern Time working hours.

  • Candidates should be prepared to discuss specific demand-generation results and metrics from previous roles.

  • This is a hands-on builder position. Candidates whose experience is primarily managing agencies, teams, or pre-built marketing systems without directly building GTM infrastructure may not be the right fit.

  • Experience or strong knowledge of investment management, asset management, alternative investments, or related financial markets is important for success in this role.

jobs.description:
Customer Success Manager (WMS/TMS)

Department: Customer Success
Reports To: Director of Account Management & Customer Success
Location: Remote – United States

About ShipHawk

ShipHawk is a leading provider of fulfillment software, helping high-volume retailers and ecommerce companies automate and optimize their warehouse and shipping operations. Our technology connects complex fulfillment workflows, giving customers greater efficiency, visibility, and control as they scale.

We’re looking for a Customer Success Manager who can combine strong customer relationship management with operational execution, technical curiosity, and commercial thinking.

About the Role

As a Customer Success Manager at ShipHawk, you’ll own the ongoing success and growth of a portfolio of customers using our WMS and TMS solutions.

This is not a purely relationship-focused Customer Success role. You’ll be expected to understand how your customers operate, identify opportunities to improve their use of ShipHawk, proactively solve problems, manage multiple customer initiatives, and recognize opportunities to expand our partnership through additional products, capabilities, and services.

The ideal candidate brings the organization and execution skills of a strong project manager, the customer orientation of a CSM, and the commercial instincts to identify and pursue expansion opportunities.

You’ll work closely with Account Management, Professional Services, Technical Support, Product, and Engineering to ensure customers realize measurable value from ShipHawk and continue to grow with us.

What You’ll Do

Own Customer Success & Retention

  • Serve as a strategic point of contact for a portfolio of ShipHawk customers.
  • Develop a strong understanding of each customer’s business, fulfillment operations, goals, technical environment, and growth plans.
  • Drive product adoption and help customers maximize the operational and business value they receive from ShipHawk.
  • Proactively identify customer risks, blockers, and areas of underutilization and develop clear action plans to address them.
  • Lead regular customer conversations, business reviews, and strategic planning discussions.
  • Build strong relationships across customer organizations, from day-to-day users to operational and executive stakeholders.
  • Own customer retention and proactively manage accounts toward successful renewal.

Drive Customer Growth & Expansion

Customer Success Managers at ShipHawk are expected to think commercially and identify opportunities to grow our relationships with customers.

  • Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities based on customer needs, business growth, operational challenges, and product usage.
  • Discover new use cases where ShipHawk products, features, services, or capabilities can create additional customer value.
  • Connect customer business objectives to relevant ShipHawk solutions and clearly articulate the business value of expanding the partnership.
  • Proactively introduce relevant capabilities rather than waiting for customers to ask for them.
  • Partner with Account Management on larger or more complex commercial opportunities, pricing, proposals, and contract discussions.
  • Maintain visibility into expansion opportunities and next steps within your portfolio.
  • Balance commercial growth with long-term customer trust and measurable customer outcomes.

Manage Customer Initiatives

  • Manage multiple customer initiatives and priorities simultaneously, ensuring clear ownership, timelines, action items, and follow-through.
  • Coordinate cross-functional resources to move customer initiatives forward.
  • Maintain clear documentation of customer goals, open issues, commitments, decisions, and next steps.
  • Proactively follow up on outstanding actions and escalate risks before they become customer-impacting problems.
  • Develop action plans when initiatives or customer outcomes are off track.
  • Hold both internal teams and customers accountable for agreed-upon deliverables and timelines.

Become a Trusted Operational Partner

  • Develop a working understanding of warehouse, fulfillment, shipping, ecommerce, and supply chain operations.
  • Understand how ShipHawk’s WMS and TMS solutions fit into customers’ broader operational and technology ecosystems.
  • Become comfortable discussing workflows, integrations, configuration, operational processes, and technical requirements with customers and internal teams.
  • Translate technical concepts into clear business outcomes for customer stakeholders.
  • Ask thoughtful questions and diagnose the underlying business problem rather than simply responding to individual requests.

Collaborate Cross-Functionally

  • Partner closely with Account Management, Professional Services, Support, Product, and Engineering.
  • Bring the right internal stakeholders into customer conversations while maintaining clear ownership of the customer relationship.
  • Surface recurring customer needs, product gaps, and operational challenges internally.
  • Provide Product and leadership with structured customer feedback and business context.
  • Help ensure customers transition successfully from implementation into ongoing Customer Success.

How We’ll Measure Success

Success in this role will include:

  • Gross Revenue Retention (GRR)
  • Net Dollar Retention (NDR)
  • Customer adoption and engagement
  • Expansion opportunities identified and converted
  • Customer health and risk management
  • Successful renewals
  • Execution and follow-through on customer commitments
  • Customer satisfaction and relationship strength

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, SaaS implementation, project management, account management, or a similar customer-facing B2B SaaS role.
  • Demonstrated experience owning complex customer relationships or customer projects.
  • Strong project and workload management skills with the ability to manage multiple customers, priorities, and workstreams simultaneously.
  • Proven ability to proactively identify problems, develop action plans, and drive issues through resolution.
  • Strong customer-facing communication and presentation skills.
  • Commercial mindset and comfort identifying upsell, cross-sell, or expansion opportunities.
  • Ability to uncover customer needs and connect them to relevant products, services, or solutions.
  • Strong organizational skills and disciplined follow-through.
  • Technical curiosity and the ability to quickly learn complex software and operational workflows.
  • Ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Comfortable operating independently in a fast-paced environment where processes continue to evolve.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), Transportation Management Systems (TMS), ERP, OMS, ecommerce, or other operational software.
  • Experience in logistics, fulfillment, supply chain, warehouse operations, or ecommerce.
  • Previous experience implementing SaaS or enterprise software.
  • Experience managing customer projects involving integrations, configuration, data, or technical workflows.
  • Experience carrying or contributing to expansion, upsell, cross-sell, renewal, or NDR targets.
  • Experience working with mid-market or enterprise customers.

Who Thrives in This Role

You may be a great fit if you:

  • Naturally take ownership rather than waiting for someone else to drive the next step.
  • Are highly organized and enjoy bringing structure to complex customer situations.
  • Can move comfortably between strategic conversations and detailed execution.
  • Are curious about how customers actually run their businesses.
  • Enjoy solving operational problems and learning technical products.
  • See commercial opportunities through the lens of customer value.
  • Are comfortable recommending additional solutions when they genuinely solve a customer problem.
  • Communicate proactively—even when the message is difficult.
  • Hold yourself and others accountable for commitments.
  • Enjoy working in an environment where you can help improve the way things are done.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary plus performance-based variable compensation ($85,000 - $110,000 OTE)
  • Fully remote work within the United States
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

jobs.title: Social Media Manager + Strategist
jobs.excerpt: Why WarriorBabe?  WarriorBabe is a women's fitness and nutrition coaching brand built for women 35+, helping them change their bodies through a hormone- and nutrition-led approach, not fad diets.
jobs.description:
Why WarriorBabe?

WarriorBabe is a women's fitness and nutrition coaching brand built for women 35+, helping them change their bodies through a hormone- and nutrition-led approach, not fad diets. We have a large, engaged audience across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and Facebook, a talent-led content engine, and a paid media program running at real scale. Organic is our biggest untapped channel.

Our Mission

Help 100,000 women regain their personal power and feel confident in their skin.

About the role

We're looking for a Social Media Manager and organic strategist to own our organic system end to end. This is not a posting-and-scheduling role, and it is not a role where someone hands you a calendar and tells you what to make. You'll set the strategy.

We have the pieces most brands are still trying to assemble: a large, loyal audience, strong on-camera personalities, a script and production pipeline already in motion, a skilled design and editing bench, and an ambassador roster. We're bringing in a Social Media Manager to take full ownership of that engine and point it at growth.

You'll own organic and social strategy, build and run the content calendar, drive concepting so we're creating content designed to break out rather than content that fills a slot, keep deliverables moving across talent, agencies, editors, and design, and own the numbers that show what's working. And we want to start to see strong numbers.You'll also connect that content to the funnel through ManyChat and chat automation, lead magnets, and sales cadence, working closely with our email team so nothing falls through the cracks between "someone engaged" and "someone in the hands of our sales team."

We want someone who thinks in strategy and systems, not tasks. If you've grown an account through a deliberate content strategy and can show us the numbers that prove it, we want to talk to you.

What you'll own

Organic and Social Strategy

  • Own the organic strategy across channels: what we post, why we post it, where it goes, and what it's supposed to do for the business and how it drives first click conversions.
  • Define and maintain our content pillars, and make sure every piece of content maps to one.
  • Build platform-native strategy per channel rather than cross-posting the same asset everywhere. Build the quarterly and monthly organic roadmap, and translate company goals into an organic plan that gets us there.
  • Broaden our content range across the education, hormone, nutrition, transformation, and empowerment angles that resonate most with a 35+ audience.

Content Calendar and Production Planning

  • Own the calendar. This is where the role has the fastest impact, and it's the first thing you'll be measured on.
  • Build and maintain a live content calendar covering filming, editing, approvals, publishing, and promotion, planned weeks ahead.
  • Block filming days with our talent in advance, get scripts reviewed and prioritized ahead of shoot days, and keep the pipeline full.
  • Plan the visual grid and content mix so every channel looks intentional.
  • Set and hold a repeatable posting cadence across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and YouTube Shorts.
  • Document the workflow so the system is repeatable and transferable.

Viral Concepting and Creative Direction

  • Own where ideas come from. Concepts should be sourced deliberately from trends, performance data, audience language, and our pillars.
  • Develop breakout concepts: hooks, formats, series, and trend adaptations built for reach.
  • Build and maintain a hook and concept library, and a swipe file of what's working in and outside our category.
  • Brief scripts, graphics, thumbnails, covers, and edits with clear creative direction so the output matches the intent.
  • Study our own outliers and competitors' outliers, then systematically replicate what works. You should be able to explain why a post broke out, not just that it did.
  • Set a target for outlier posts every week and be accountable to hitting it.

Deliverable and Vendor Orchestration

  • Know where everything lives. We work with an external script agency, multiple editors, a graphic designer, on-camera talent, and an ambassador roster. You are the hub making sure everything gets incorporated.
  • Manage the deliverable pipeline in ClickUp: assign, track, and close out. Nothing sits. •
  • Hold agencies, editors, and designers to deadline and quality standards, and forecast capacity so the calendar always has what it needs.
  • Route content through QC and brand review cleanly, so quality stays high and turnaround stays fast.
  • Maintain organized, accessible asset libraries. Anyone should be able to find the right asset without asking you.

Performance Ownership and Reporting

  • Own the numbers. Not as an after-the-fact report, but as the input that drives next week's plan.
  • Build and run unified channel-level reporting: growth, engagement, views, saves, shares, cadence, and outliers, booked sales calls, all in one place.
  • Own the weekly organic scorecard and report to leadership on what worked, what didn't, and what you're changing because of it.
  • Own attribution hygiene: tracking links, UTMs, bios, and descriptions, so we can tie organic directly to leads and booked calls.
  • Set CTA strategy so content drives measurable action, not just follows.
  • Identify top-performing organic assets and hand them to the paid team for repurposing, preserving social proof via post IDs.

Chat and Email Automation

Build and manage ManyChat flows tied to our keyword-trigger framework (MACROS, RECIPE, HORMONE, WORKOUT, QUIZ, and more), and coordinate with our email team's automation workflows so content, chat, and email work as one system rather than three separate ones. Own the health of these flows so they're always live and always converting.

Lead Magnet Strategy

Audit and refresh the lead magnets on warriorbabe.com/shop and roll out new ones monthly as content volume grows: PDFs, recipes, and guides pulled from what's actually resonating in the content.

Sales Cadence Coordination

Align social and chat touchpoints with our sales follow-up cadence so engagement actually converts, not just accumulates. You're measured on movement toward a sale, not just likes and follows.

Community and Engagement

Keep comments, DMs, and community response on-brand and timely, coordinating with our community lead. Surface testimonials and client wins from the community and turn them into content.

Collaboration and Partnership Management

Source and manage collaborations that grow reach: podcast guest spots for our founder, creator partnerships, cross-posts, and collab posts. Support the ambassador program with briefs, scripts, and a current content vault so ambassadors post on-brand independently.

What you bring

  • Proven organic strategy experience with numbers to back it. You have built an organic strategy from scratch or rebuilt a struggling one, and you can walk us through the before and after: follower growth, engagement, views, and ideally leads or revenue. Come ready to talk specifics.
  • You are exceptionally organized. Calendars, trackers, and documented processes are how you work, not something you'll get to later. You build systems that keep running whether or not you're in the room.
  • A track record of breakout content. You've made things that took off, and you can explain the thinking behind them. You know how to build a hook, a format, and a series, and how to spot a trend worth adapting.
  • Proven experience managing and growing a high-performing Instagram account. DTC, wellness, fitness, or coaching space strongly preferred. TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Facebook experience strongly preferred.
  • Comfort with numbers. You can build a report, read engagement and conversion data, and use it to make decisions, not just report on it. Experience with analytics and attribution tooling is a plus.
  • Experience coordinating creative production. Briefing editors, designers, agencies, and on-camera talent, and holding deadlines across all of them.
  • Hands-on experience with ManyChat or a comparable chat-automation platform.
  • Working knowledge of email marketing/automation platforms and funnel logic. You don't need to own email, but you need to speak its language and coordinate with the team that does.
  • A real grasp of lead magnet strategy and how content, chat, and email work together to convert an audience into customers.
  • Strong writing skills and a good ear for brand voice. You can write copy that doesn't sound like AI or a corporate account: short, punchy, fifth-grade reading level, no em dashes.
  • A self-starter mentality, comfortable moving fast and owning outcomes in a small, in house team.

Nice to Have

  • Experience marketing in the fitness/wellness/coaching space.
  • Familiarity with TikTok Shop or e-commerce-linked content.
  • Experience briefing, training, or managing ambassador or affiliate creators.
  • Experience building an in-house content function.
  • Familiarity with ClickUp, Metricool, Canva, or comparable tools.

How We'll Measure Success

  • A live content calendar built and held, with filming planned ahead and posting cadence hit consistently.
  • Growth in organic-sourced leads and booked calls, with clean attribution behind the numbers. •
  • A consistent rate of outlier posts, and a documented reason behind each one.
  • Follower and engagement growth across priority channels.
  • Weekly scorecard reporting leadership can trust.
  • A fully documented organic playbook the whole team can run from.

Compensation

  • Base Salary: $65,000–$75,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications
  • Performance-Based Bonuses & Incentives: Additional earning opportunities tied to individual and company performance
  • Total Compensation: Competitive base salary with opportunities to increase earnings through performance

Who You Are:

The Talent Management Partner will independently own execution of workstreams across performance, careers, compensation, and broader talent initiatives. This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong analytical capability with sound judgment and can support translation of talent problems into scalable solutions, through close partnership with PBPs and functional leaders.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Performance & Careers

  • Apply established job evaluation frameworks to evaluate roles, document rationale, and flag cases requiring calibration for levelling decisions.
  • Maintain job architectures, career paths, level descriptors and progression criteria; incorporate approved changes and maintain version control/source of truth.
  • Partner with People Business Partners (PBPs) to track architecture gaps and recommend changes when the nature or complexity of work materially evolves.
  • Independently own execution of assigned modules during performance and promotion review cycles.
  • Analyze talent outcomes to identify patterns, inconsistencies, and opportunities for improvement.

Compensation & Rewards

  • Conduct market benchmarking using global data platforms to support compensation recommendations.
  • Analyze compensation and talent data to support pay range design, hiring, retention, promotion, and workforce decisions.
  • Apply established compensation principles consistently while identifying and escalating exceptions, inconsistencies, and emerging organizational patterns.
  • Maintain equity/rewards datasets, run defined analyses and support reporting for strategic rewards initiatives.

Project Coordination & Data Analytics

  • Maintain project plans, trackers, dependencies, schedules and completion reporting across talent management initiatives.
  • Build scalable dashboards and standardized reporting templates across initiatives.
  • Use Apps Script, GPT/API-based workflows and other automation tools to reduce manual work across recurring analysis, reporting, data validation and talent operations.
  • Build and maintain automated data pipelines between talent datasets and reporting outputs, with appropriate data quality and exception flags.

Stakeholder Consulting

  • Serve as the first point of support for PBPs on established talent processes, data and frameworks; resolve standard queries and escalate judgment-heavy cases.
  • Analyze issues, validate data and develop options/inputs for decision-making.
  • Maintain documentation and templates that enable consistent application of Talent Management processes.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in Talent Management, Compensation/Rewards, People Consulting, Performance, Organization Design, or related disciplines.
  • Hands-on compensation experience across market benchmarking, salary structures and pay design.
  • Working knowledge of job evaluation methodologies, such as Aon, Korn Ferry/Hay, Mercer IPE, or equivalent.
  • Strong analytical and modeling capability with advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills and the ability to translate complex data into actionable recommendations.
  • Aptitude to create basic Appscript/ChatGPT API-Based workflows to reduce manual effort in recurring tasks.
  • Knowledge of career architecture, leveling, performance, and organization design principles.
  • Strong stakeholder consulting and communication to explain complex concepts clearly.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and exercise sound judgment when applying talent and compensation principles.
  • Experience working in a global workforce.

Preferred

  • Experience in talent/rewards consulting, including Mercer, Aon, WTW, Korn Ferry, Big 4 People Advisory, or similar.
  • Experience in SaaS, technology, or another high-growth environment.
  • Exposure to equity compensation, global compensation, or pay-equity analysis.

About IonQ:

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

Location: US, Remote - global remit
Travel: Significant domestic and international travel expected
Job ID: 1879

The Role:

IonQ is seeking a Global Alliances Lead to develop a small, carefully selected portfolio of lighthouse advisory and consulting partners, such as McKinsey, BCG, Accenture and EY. The role owns the worldwide relationship and joint business plan, with a focus on executive commitment, shared customer pursuits and measurable commercial outcomes. The role covers IonQ’s entire portfolio—compute, networking, security, sensing, space and merchant services—with focused pursuits selected to match each lighthouse partner’s capabilities and customer needs.

Our frontier technologies require partners to learn through real customer work. With selected consulting firms and systems integrators, jointly shape and co-sell quantum security and computing solutions spanning hardware deployment in customer data centers, remote cloud access, and quantum application and algorithm development, alongside quantum-safe cybersecurity assessments and migration engagements. Work with IonQ technical specialists to validate customer needs and feasible outcomes. Collaborate with regional partner leads to activate these global alliances locally, build success stories and replicate what proves effective.

Responsibilities:

Lighthouse Partner Selection & Commitment

  • Select a few priority advisory/consulting firms and practices based on customer relevance, executive sponsorship, quantum capacity and willingness to commit people and investment to joint opportunities.
  • Own global joint plans with explicit industry and regional priorities, shared customer targets, partner resources and milestones; deepen successful relationships before adding partners.

Hands-On Co-Sell and Commercialization

  • Personally engage partner practice leaders and account teams in customer discovery, opportunity qualification, business-case development and commercial pursuits. Develop a focused set of lighthouse engagements, selected for customer value and technical readiness, across quantum computing and quantum-safe cybersecurity
  • Work with Field Engineering, Partner Engineering and Platform Sales Specialists to establish feasible scope, technical success criteria, dependencies and growth milestones for all quantum engagements. Partner Engineering ensures technical alignment and integration; Field Engineering and Platform Sales Specialists support customer discovery, solution development and live pursuits across the full portfolio: compute, networking, security, sensing, space and merchant services.
  • . Build seller confidence through joint execution and evidence from customer work, creating a credible path from initial engagement to follow-on adoption.

  • Teach by doing: jointly discover needs, qualify use cases, shape solutions, co-sell and deliver early engagements. Build reusable success stories and playbooks, then expand based on evidence of repeatability.

Global–Regional Opportunity Execution

  • Own the named worldwide alliance and mobilize partner headquarters, global executive sponsors, programs, practice expertise and commercial frameworks for regional quantum opportunities; regional partner leads develop local partner teams and coordinate execution in close alignment with regional sales leads.
  • With regional partner leads and regional sales leads, map named advisory/consulting accounts and local partner practices, assign pursuit responsibilities and run shared account plans, pipeline and deal reviews with agreed customer outcomes.
  • Use regional customer evidence to refine global offerings, resolve cross-region issues and bring successful approaches to additional partner practices and markets.

Commercial Governance & Replication

  • Lead alliance commercial frameworks and joint investments with Legal and Finance; maintain qualified pipeline and forecasts. Track each opportunity in one shared record with distinct global and regional contributions.
  • Secure customer-approved quantum computing and quantum-safe cybersecurity success stories and capture delivery lessons, partner economics and reusable pursuit playbooks. Work with Programs and Marketing to turn lighthouse engagement lessons into reusable tools, and GTM approaches.
  • Expand to further accounts, practices or partners when lighthouse results demonstrate customer value, partner commitment and a repeatable commercial path.

Requirements:

  • 8+ years in strategic alliances, including ownership of complex relationships with advisory or consulting firms. Credibility with senior consulting practice and industry leaders; understanding of consulting economics and how to turn advisory influence into joint opportunities.
  • A proven track record of developing focused, early-stage partnerships into scalable channels that deliver sustained revenue growth.
  • Demonstrated commercial expertise in frontier technologies or an emerging technology category: translating uncertain capabilities, evolving roadmaps and customer needs into credible, staged adoption plans.
  • A record of building a small number of deep partnerships and personally co-selling early customer engagements, from discovery and qualification through solution development, negotiation and close.
  • Strong executive communication, commercial negotiation and cross-functional leadership; discipline in pipeline qualification, forecasting and investment prioritization.
  • Experience converting early customer engagements into approved references, reusable solution patterns and repeatable partner sales motions.
  • Ability to operate globally and travel; master’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Quantum experience is an advantage, including quantum computing, networking and security, space or sensing. Relevant experience may include commercialization, partnerships, customer adoption or technical solution development.
  • Experience with sovereign or regulated markets, public-sector procurement, or international trade compliance relevant to advanced technology.
  • Ability to work closely with technical specialists, distinguish validated capabilities from future potential, and establish customer success criteria without overstating readiness.

Primary Measures of Success

  • Qualified partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, closed revenue, conversion and forecast accuracy, with documented attribution and no double counting across global and regional teams.

  • Evidence of replication: customer-approved success stories, reusable playbooks, follow-on opportunities and repeat wins; additional partners activated only when delivery capacity and repeatability support expansion.

Within the first year, you will have secured referenceable wins from a few carefully selected local and global lighthouse partners and jointly progressed qualified customer engagements toward successful technical and commercial outcomes. You will have established an effective global–regional pursuit cadence and documented the evidence, partner capability and playbooks needed to replicate success.
