  • Understanding of packet processing, ASIC or FPGA forwarding logic, and high-speed switching.

  • Background in graph theory or network optimization, with modeling and simulation tools for network performance analysis.

  • Contributions to networking projects, internally or open-source, and understanding of regulatory considerations for communications systems.

The opportunity

Our client is looking for atalented Graphic Designerto bring their brand to life through high-quality static creative across their website, advertising, email, social media, packaging, and brand assets.This role is ideal for an artist with strong visual taste, a refined eye for composition, typography, color, and detail, and the ability to consistently produce polished work across different formats.The focus is on artistry, craft, consistency, and the ability to extend an established visual identity rather than reinvent it.

About the Organization

Our client is a Palestinian-owned, mission-led organization connecting small-scale farmers across Palestine directly with consumers worldwide. Their model is farm-first and regenerative, built around long-term partnerships with trusted growers, fairer pricing, and single-estate extra virgin olive oils sourced using traditional and modern cold-press methods.

Every bottle is fully traceable to its specific region and farm and reflects the people, land, and centuries-old heritage behind the product. Beyond commerce, the organization aims to create a global gateway for Palestinian farmers to share their produce, culture, and commitment to sustainable practices.The client’s name and additional details will be shared with shortlisted candidates before the client interview.

What you will do

  • Create high-quality static creative across website and product pages, advertising, email, social media, packaging, product design support, and brand assets.

  • Translate the Creative Director’s art direction, concepts, templates, and feedback into polished, production-ready designs.

  • Work within and extend existing brand guidelines, templates, typography, color palettes, layouts, and design systems while maintaining a consistent visual identity.

  • Adapt creative concepts across different placements, dimensions, formats, and markets while maintaining brand consistency.

  • Design ad statics and carousels, as well as email, social, website, and product-page graphics.

  • Support packaging and product design needs, ensuring physical and digital creative remain cohesive.

  • Work from creative briefs and collaborate with the Creative Strategist and Retention Manager to understand requirements and deliverables.

  • Manage multiple creative requests, iterate based on feedback, and deliver consistently high-quality work at an agreed pace.

  • Prepare final assets accurately for their intended digital or print applications.

  • Use strong judgment around composition, typography, color, hierarchy, spacing, and visual storytelling.

  • Work independently and reliably, managing priorities, deadlines, communication, and deliverables as a remote contractor.

What you bring

  • An artist-first approach to design, with a strong portfolio demonstrating visual craft, taste, range, and quality across brand and marketing design.

  • A strong eye for composition, typography, color, layout, hierarchy, and visual detail.

  • Professional experience creatingstatic graphic design across multiple surfaces, including web, social, advertising, email, print, or packaging.

  • Strong proficiency withFigma, Photoshop, and Illustrator.

  • Ability to work within an established brand identity and execute someone else’s creative direction while maintaining your own high standard of craft.

  • Experience adapting creative across different formats, placements, and channels while maintaining consistency.

  • Strong attention to detail, reliability, and the ability to produce polished work consistently across a batch of deliverables.

  • Ability to take feedback, iterate quickly, and manage multiple creative requests and deadlines.

  • Commitment to creating original design work without AI-generated imagery, in line with the brand’s emphasis on authenticity and real, provable origin.

Helpful but not essential

  • Experience designing for direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands.

  • Experience with advertising and marketing creative.

  • Experience with motion design or animation.

  • Experience with packaging or product design.

  • Familiarity with the Palestinian story, culture, and mission, or a strong personal connection to the organization’s purpose.

Job Title: Director, Capture Management

Location: Remote – US preferred

Compensation: $150,000 - $175,000 + Bonus/Commission Eligible

Citizenship Requirement: US Citizenship required

Travel: Up to 10%

Who we are: Lynx delivers modular, open standards–based software that transforms how high-assurance, mission-critical edge systems are built, deployed, and maintained. Our secure edge computing solutions enable innovation and operational excellence in the world’s most demanding environments, from aerospace and defense to commercial and industrial systems. We partner across industries including automotive, medical, and critical infrastructure to deliver tailored solutions aligned with each customer’s mission and operational requirements. Our key products and services are:

  • MOSA.ic: LYNX MOSA.ic™ is a modular software framework and architecture purpose-built for mission-critical edge computing. Based on the Modular Open Systems Approach (MOSA), it provides a flexible foundation for building secure, scalable, and certifiable edge systems.
  • LYNX MOSA.ic.AI: LYNX MOSA.ic.AI is a unified CPU and GPU software platform that enables deterministic, certifiable deployment of AI and advanced workloads in mission-critical edge systems. It brings control, performance, and lifecycle governance together, allowing AI to operate predictably within safety-critical environments without compromising certification or system integrity.
  • CoreSuite 2.0: CoreSuite 2.0 is Lynx’s safety-critical GPU for graphics enablement framework designed for mission-critical edge computing systems. It provides hardware-accelerated graphics, visualization, and video processing capabilities that can be certified for high-assurance systems.
  • Services: Lynx Services is Lynx’s professional services organization that helps customers design, integrate, certify, deploy, and maintain safety- and security-critical systems. It supports industries like aerospace, defense, automotive, and industrial computing through consulting, engineering, integration, and lifecycle support, reducing development risk and accelerating certification in standards-driven, mission-critical environment.

Role Overview

Lynx Software Technologies is seeking an experienced Director, Capture Management to help drive strategic growth across the Aerospace, Defense, and Safety-Critical Systems markets. This individual will lead the capture and proposal lifecycle for high-value opportunities involving real-time operating systems, virtualization, cybersecurity, safety certification, GPU software, AI deployment platforms, and software engineering services.

The successful candidate will partner closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Marketing, and Executive Leadership to identify, qualify, capture, and win opportunities with government agencies, prime contractors, system integrators, and commercial aerospace customers worldwide.

This role requires a blend of capture management, proposal leadership, and technical storytelling skills, with a strong understanding of the defense acquisition process and the unique challenges of commercial software sales into regulated markets.

Key Responsibilities

Capture Management

  • Lead capture efforts for strategic opportunities from qualification through contract award.
  • Develop and execute capture plans, win strategies, competitive assessments, stakeholder maps, and account penetration strategies.
  • Conduct customer and partner research to identify buying influences, program funding sources, acquisition pathways, and competitive positioning.
  • Support opportunity qualification using established criteria, including strategic fit, probability of win, revenue potential, and resource requirements.
  • Drive teaming and partnership strategies with defense primes, hardware vendors, system integrators, and channel partners.

Proposal Leadership

  • Manage the end-to-end proposal lifecycle, including kickoff meetings, compliance reviews, schedule management, color team reviews, and final submission.
  • Create proposal outlines, compliance matrices, response templates, and proposal management plans.
  • Coordinate contributions from technical SMEs, product leaders, engineering teams, and executive stakeholders.
  • Ensure proposals are compliant, compelling, and clearly aligned with customer requirements and evaluation criteria.
  • Maintain proposal repositories, reusable content libraries, past performance databases, and proposal best practices.

Technical & Executive Content Development

  • Write and edit executive summaries, management approaches, technical narratives, and value propositions.
  • Translate complex software technologies into customer-focused benefits and discriminators.
  • Develop compelling win themes around safety certification, cybersecurity, open architecture, software portability, lifecycle cost reduction, and mission assurance.
  • Support customer presentations, white papers, RFI responses, capability statements, and strategic pursuit documents.

Government Contracting & Compliance

  • Analyze solicitations and contractual requirements for compliance with FAR, DFARS, ITAR, EAR, cybersecurity, and software licensing requirements.
  • Support reviews of data rights, intellectual property provisions, software licensing terms, and security requirements.
  • Coordinate with legal, contracts, and finance teams throughout the pursuit process.
  • Maintain awareness of emerging acquisition trends including OTAs, SBIR/STTR, CSOs, IDIQs, and other non-traditional contracting mechanisms.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Sales and Business Development teams to advance strategic opportunities and improve win rates.
  • Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering to align customer requirements with product roadmaps and technical capabilities.
  • Work with Marketing to create targeted campaign messaging, pursuit-specific collateral, and customer-facing content.
  • Provide regular pursuit status updates, risk assessments, and recommendations to executive leadership.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, Engineering, Marketing, or a related discipline.
  • 7+ years of experience in capture management, proposal management, business development, or strategic pursuits within Aerospace, Defense, or Government Technology markets.
  • Demonstrated success winning complex opportunities exceeding $1M in value.
  • Strong working knowledge of FAR, DFARS, DoD acquisition processes, and government procurement practices.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, and executive communication skills.
  • Experience managing cross-functional teams in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Ability to understand and communicate technical software solutions to both business and technical audiences.
  • Experience using proposal and collaboration tools such as SharePoint, Microsoft 365, Privia, GovWin, Salesforce, or similar platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling or supporting software, embedded systems, cybersecurity, virtualization, RTOS, AI/ML, cloud, or safety-critical technologies.
  • Familiarity with aerospace and defense standards including DO-178C, FACE, MOSA, SOSA, NIST SP 800-171, RMF, and related frameworks.
  • Shipley Capture and Proposal Certifications.
  • Experience supporting international defense opportunities and export-controlled programs.
  • Active U.S. Security Clearance or eligibility to obtain one.

Success Metrics

  • Increased proposal win rate and capture effectiveness.
  • Growth in qualified pipeline and strategic opportunity conversion.
  • Improved proposal quality, compliance, and submission efficiency.
  • Development of reusable content and pursuit processes that scale across the organization.
  • Contribution to annual bookings, revenue growth, and strategic account expansion.

Sound Exciting? Get in touch today! We have very robust benefits including:

  • Low-cost Medical / Dental / Vision coverage options
  • 401K with generous employer match
  • Responsible Paid Time Off + Paid Holidays
  • Remote work opportunities based on role
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Career growth and professional development opportunities

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Head of Design
jobs.excerpt: Elation Health exists to enable every patient to experience the highest quality care wherever they go in the healthcare system.
jobs.description:
Elation Health exists to enable every patient to experience the highest quality care wherever they go in the healthcare system. We build technology for independent primary care practices and the physicians, clinicians, and teams who care for their patients every day.

Our platform brings together a clinical-first EHR, intelligent automation, billing, patient engagement, and the workflows that help primary care practices deliver excellent care and build sustainable businesses. The work is consequential: when our products are clear, trustworthy, and well designed, clinicians can spend more time focused on patients and less time fighting their tools.

Primary care is foundational to a healthy healthcare system, yet the technology supporting it is often fragmented, burdensome, and disconnected from the realities of clinical work. At Elation, Design has the opportunity to make the experience of practicing medicine meaningfully better—while helping independent primary care remain strong, sustainable, and human.

We are seeking a passionate Design leader to drive our design strategy, build a strongly capable Design organization, raise the quality and coherence of the product experience, and use AI-native ways of working to deliver more intuitive, trusted, and impactful experiences for clinicians and practices at scale. If you’re excited about shaping the next generation of AI-native primary care technology, this role is for you.

The opportunity

As Head of Design, you will set the vision, standards, and operating model for Design at Elation. You will lead a talented team of product designers and design partners, work closely with Product and Engineering leadership, and bring a strong design point of view to company strategy and product decisions.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can move comfortably between the strategic and the concrete: defining a coherent experience across a complex product, coaching designers through difficult problems, raising the quality bar, and ensuring the details hold up in the hands of real clinicians.

You will report to the Chief Product Officer and serve as a senior voice in the Product Development organization. The title and scope will be calibrated to the experience and demonstrated impact of the person we hire.

What you’ll do

  • Set and communicate a clear design vision for Elation’s product experience, grounded in our clinical-first principles and the realities of primary care.
  • Lead and shape an AI-native Design organization with a durable operating model for how designers, agents, and cross-functional teams work together to create higher-quality experiences at greater speed. Elation is already well on this journey, with AI-native product strategy, evolving design systems, and emerging AI-assisted design-review practices.
  • Build a high-performing Design function: clarify roles and responsibilities, establish effective operating rhythms, create growth paths, and hire and retain exceptional design talent.
  • Partner with the CPO, product leaders, engineering leaders, and executive stakeholders to translate company strategy into a focused product experience strategy and roadmap.
  • Raise the quality bar across the end-to-end user experience, including research, service design, product strategy, interaction design, visual design, content, accessibility, and customer enablement.
  • Strengthen the systems that allow design to scale: principles, patterns, documentation, design systems, research practices, reusable frameworks, and the connection between design artifacts and shipped product. Implement a practical design-review culture that improves decisions early, creates shared standards, protects team velocity, and makes quality everyone’s responsibility.
  • Foster deep empathy for clinicians and practice teams by embedding a rigorous culture of user research across product development—engaging directly with clinical and billing experts through co-design, workflow observation, and qualitative and quantitative insights.
  • Help teams solve the right problems before they move quickly on the wrong ones. Create clarity in ambiguous spaces and make tradeoffs explicit.
  • Partner closely with Engineering to ensure that design intent survives implementation and that the finished experience is reliable, coherent, accessible, and delightful to use.
  • Develop designers as leaders and active contributors to product direction—not simply as owners of screens or deliverables.
  • Represent the customer and the design perspective in senior leadership discussions, product prioritization, launch decisions, and company-wide conversations about quality.
  • Create an environment where designers can do their best work: one that is candid, collaborative, intellectually curious, and accountable for impact.

What success looks like

We will measure success through a combination of customer impact, product quality, organizational health, and operating leverage. In particular, we expect this leader to improve:

  • Clinician and practice-team experience, including usability, consistency, and confidence in Elation’s products.
  • Design quality and product coherence, with fewer late-stage design issues and less avoidable rework.
  • The quality and consistency of customer insight used in product decisions.
  • Design team health, retention, hiring, growth, and clarity of ownership.
  • Product Development velocity through stronger design systems, review practices, reusable patterns, and AI-native ways of working.

What we’re looking for

  • Significant experience leading product design in a complex, multi-surface, or highly regulated environment. Experience in healthcare, health technology, enterprise SaaS, or another domain where trust and workflow quality matter is especially valuable.
  • A track record of building, scaling, or materially strengthening a design organization, including hiring, coaching, org design, and talent development.
  • Strong product judgment and the ability to connect design decisions to customer outcomes, business strategy, and technical realities.
  • Experience partnering effectively with Product and Engineering leaders and influencing decisions beyond the Design function.
  • Deep fluency across the UX stack: research, service design, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, systems thinking, and design operations.
  • A strong point of view on design quality, paired with the humility and communication skills to develop that point of view with others.
  • The ability to make complex systems understandable and usable without flattening the nuance that matters.
  • A demonstrated commitment to customer-centered, evidence-informed decision making.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to make design rationale clear to executives, cross-functional partners, and designers at every level.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, creating structure where it is needed, and making thoughtful decisions without waiting for perfect information.

Salary: $200,000 - $260,000k/yr + variable

Elation welcomes individuals from all backgrounds and walks of life. Elation is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is dedicated to creating and maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment.

We are committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, and value individuals with diverse perspectives including, but not limited to: race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Elation also complies with all applicable national, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and IRCA. We firmly believe a strong culture that supports a diverse and inclusive workforce allows us to achieve Elation’s mission of helping independent primary care thrive.

Overview

Since 1972, Covenant House has served and advocated for youth and young families experiencing homelessness, human trafficking, and exploitation. Our overarching goal is to end homelessness among youth and young families by helping them achieve housing stability, heal from trauma, tap into their innate resilience, and hone their interests and skills to forge new pathways to independence. This work is carried out across Covenant House sites in 34 cities in the US, Canada, Mexico, Guatemala, and Honduras.

About the Role

The Senior Vice President, Foundation Relations is a strategic and entrepreneurial fundraising executive responsible for leading Covenant House International's foundation fundraising program and securing transformational philanthropic investments from private foundations. Reporting directly to the Chief Philanthropy Officer, the SVP will focus primarily on identifying, cultivating, soliciting, and stewarding major commitments from foundations capable of making seven- and eight-figure investments.

The SVP will expand Covenant House's foundation portfolio by developing and securing significant new funding relationships with international, national, regional, family, and private foundations whose priorities align with Covenant House's mission and strategic objectives. The successful candidate will be a proven fundraiser with extensive experience securing multiple multi-million-dollar commitments and multi-year grants from leading private foundations.

This leader will manage a team of frontline foundation relations officers and grant writers responsible for prospect development, cultivation, proposal development, reporting, and ongoing foundation engagement. The SVP will establish ambitious revenue goals, implement best practices across the foundation relations function, and build a high-performing team capable of sustaining significant growth.

As a senior leader within the revenue organization, the SVP will help shape fundraising strategy, foster cross-functional collaboration, and model Covenant House's values of unconditional love, absolute respect, and relentless support. This position requires a self-starter with exceptional judgment, initiative, and accountability who can operate independently and achieve ambitious goals with minimal supervision.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Foundation Fundraising Strategy and Revenue Growth

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive foundation relations strategy focused on securing transformational seven- and eight-figure investments from international, national, regional, family, and private foundations

  • Build and maintain a robust pipeline of high-capacity foundation prospects capable of making significant multi-year commitments

  • Personally manage a portfolio of the organization's most significant foundation prospects and funders

  • Identify, cultivate, solicit, and steward new foundation partners whose philanthropic priorities align with Covenant House's mission and strategic plan

  • Lead complex funding discussions and negotiate major grant awards and multi-year commitments

  • Build a collaborative, high-performing culture centered on excellence, innovation, results, and continuous learning

  • Create systems and processes that improve proposal development, grant management, prospect tracking, and foundation stewardship

  • Ensure effective coordination between frontline fundraising activities and grant writing functions

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Coordinate institution-wide strategies involving major funding opportunities that require collaboration across multiple departments and subject-matter experts.

  • Work closely with program leaders to develop compelling cases for support and foundation funding opportunities.

  • Collaborate with donor relations colleagues when foundation trustees, family members, or family offices present opportunities for individual major gifts.

  • Partner with corporate partnerships colleagues when foundations and corporate philanthropy initiatives overlap.

  • Engage executive leadership and board members in cultivation and solicitation efforts when appropriate.

Organizational Leadership

  • Represent Covenant House with credibility and professionalism among foundation leaders and external stakeholders.

  • Model Covenant House's values and demonstrate a commitment to mission-centered leadership.

  • Promote a culture of collaboration, accountability, integrity, inclusion, and shared success

  • Provide strategic insights regarding philanthropy trends, institutional funding opportunities, and long-term revenue diversification

Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Deep expertise in foundation fundraising and institutional philanthropy

  • Strong understanding of the foundation landscape, including major family, independent, regional, national, and international foundations

  • Proven ability to identify, cultivate, and close new foundation funding relationships

  • Expertise in developing comprehensive institutional fundraising strategies aligned with organizational priorities

  • Exceptional relationship-building skills with foundation executives, trustees, program officers, and philanthropic advisors

  • Strong leadership and team management capabilities

  • Ability to develop and communicate complex cases for support tailored to institutional funders

  • Exceptional writing, editing, and proposal development skills

  • Outstanding presentation and verbal communication abilities

  • Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills

  • Strong understanding of grant budgeting, proposal development, compliance, stewardship, and reporting requirements

  • High degree of initiative, accountability, and independent judgment

  • Strong project management and organizational skills

  • Ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines within a fast-paced environment

  • Passion for Covenant House's mission and demonstrated commitment to serving vulnerable youth

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 12-15 years of progressively responsible fundraising experience, including substantial experience in foundation relations and institutional giving

  • Demonstrated success securing seven- and eight-figure grants and multi-year commitments from private foundations

  • Proven success securing seven- and eight-figure grants from national, regional, family, and private foundations

  • Experience building and managing portfolios of major foundation prospects and funders

  • Significant experience developing new foundation partnerships and generating substantial new revenue

  • Demonstrated success leading foundation fundraising strategies that achieve sustained revenue growth

  • Experience managing frontline fundraising professionals and grant writing teams.

  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and consistently achieve ambitious fundraising goals with minimal supervision

  • Sound Judgment and Decision-Making

Day-to-Day

jobs.title: Senior Affiliate Manager
jobs.excerpt: WHO ARE WE? Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company.
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

Why This Seat

Our publisher book is growing faster than the team can reach it, and this seat exists to close that gap. You will carry a margin number from the start, own your accounts end to end, and ramp in weeks rather than quarters.

Room to build, not inherit. Publishers are arriving faster than we can onboard them, so the accounts you grow are ones you shaped rather than ones handed to you finished.

Multiple verticals, not one. Insurance, personal finance, and our wider partner network. Most affiliate manager seats narrow over time until you are the person who does one thing. This one is built to broaden. You start where you are strongest and pick up the rest as you go.

Our own offers behind you. You are not selling inventory a publisher has already seen from four other networks. That changes how the conversation goes.

What You'll Bring

  • Four or more years managing publishers in affiliate. Direct publisher or partner management for an advertiser or a network.
  • A margin or revenue number you personally owned. You can name it, name where it started, and name what you changed.
  • A regulated vertical. Insurance, credit, lending, health, or personal finance, and the judgment that comes with working inside real constraints.
  • You treat a no as incomplete information. When an opportunity stalls on compliance, you find out precisely what blocked it, then work both sides reshaping the partner's assets, or making the case internally where the rule allows room. You don't abandon good opportunities and you don't wait for someone else to solve them.
  • Tracking platform fluency. You are comfortable in a performance platform and you can tell when the data is lying. We use Tune, with IntegriShield and Lashback on the compliance side. If you learned somewhere else, that is fine.
  • Proactive optimization. You read the reporting, you see where a partner could scale or optimize, and you act. Spotting it is not the skill. Doing something about it is.

Nice to Have

  • Depth of relationship in insurance specifically
  • More than one regulated vertical
  • Experience across both direct publisher relationships and network distribution

What You'll Own

  • Your publishers, end to end. The relationship, the opportunities, the scaling, the results.
  • The margin on your book. You will have a number. You will know where you are against it.
  • A book that stays diversified. If one partner going quiet takes half your margin with it, the book is built wrong. Managing that risk is part of the job, not something you do once it becomes urgent.
  • Compliance, before it becomes a problem. You monitor partner traffic actively and catch the issue while it is still small, then raise it with the partner directly.
  • The relationship itself. Not just answering when a partner writes. Keeping them warm, keeping them moving, keeping them glad they work with us.
  • What you learn, shared. We have a weekly session on what is working, and people flag things in between without being asked. That exchange is how this team gets better, and it only works if everyone puts in.

What Great Looks Like

  • In 90 days, you know our offers, our platform, and your partners. You have had your first real optimization conversation with a publisher and it moved a number.
  • In 6 months, you are running your book independently and pacing against your margin target, and you have started picking up the verticals you did not arrive with.
  • In 12 months, you have driven $500,000 in incremental margin, your book survives a partner going quiet, and someone else on the team is running a play you figured out.

This Isn't the Right Seat If You

  • Want a book that is already built and a slow quarter to learn it
  • Treat compliance as a wall rather than a problem to solve internally and externally
  • Prefer to specialize narrowly and stay there
  • Margin at or below $200,000 in a single year. No direct affiliate publisher management.

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Director, Digital Workplace Training

College Board | Office of the CEO

Location: This is a fully remote role. Candidates who live near College Board offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office).

Type: This is a full-time position.

About the Team

The Office of the CEO (OCEO) is a small, high-leverage enterprise team that operates at the center of College Board. Working directly with the CEO, President, and senior leaders, OCEO strengthens and accelerates mission impact by ensuring the organization moves in a coherent, disciplined, and aligned way. The office brings together executive leadership support and enterprise execution, connecting strategy to action and enabling leaders to focus on what matters most for students.

Digital Workplace is a core function within OCEO focused on the systems, norms, and operating habits that enable modern execution in a distributed organization. The team is responsible for turning collaboration platforms and productivity tools into a connected digital workplace that supports clarity, transparency, and speed at scale. By establishing shared standards for how information is organized, how work is coordinated, and how leaders and teams collaborate day to day, Digital Workplace reduces friction, improves execution quality, and helps the organization operate as One College Board, regardless of location.

About the Opportunity

As Director, Digital Workplace Training, you will build the enterprise capability and confidence requiredfor effective, consistent use of CollegeBoard's digital workplace. In a distributed organization with shared tools and ambitious execution goals, productivity depends not just on access to technology but on whether leaders and staff understand how to use those tools in aligned, purposeful ways. This role exists to build that fluency at scale.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Digital Workplace within the Office of the CEO, you will design and deliver enterprise learning, onboarding, and enablement that reinforce intended usage patterns and support consistent ways of working across the organization. You will translate digital workplace strategy, standards, and workflows into clear, practical learning experiences that help leaders, staff, and their support teams work with greater clarity, speed, and confidence.

Our ideal candidate understands that effective enterprise training is not about content volume or one-time sessions. It is about behavior change, reinforcement, and confidence over time. You bring strong judgment, a learner-centered mindset, and the ability to design enablement that actually sticks in complex organizational environments.

In this role, you will

Enterprise Digital Workplace Learning Strategy (30%)

  • Define the enterprise approach to digital workplace learning, aligned to priority workflows, standards, and execution expectations.

  • Establish required learning pathways for key roles, including leaders, managers, staff, Executive Assistants, and Special Assistants.

  • Ensure learning priorities are driven by enterprise execution needs and adoption gaps, not just tool releases.

Learning Design and Scalable Enablement (25%)

  • Design and deliver practical, role-specific learning experiences that build confidence and consistency in using enterprise digital tools.

  • Develop scalable learning assets (playbooks, guides, templates, and job aids) that reinforce intended usage patterns and shared ways of working.

  • Ensure learning emphasizes real workflows and behaviors rather than abstract tool functionality.

Enterprise Onboarding and Change Enablement (20%)

  • Integrate digital workplace learning into enterprise and divisional onboarding experiences.

  • Partner with the Digital Workplace Product Manager and Technology during major tool, platform, or workflow changes to deliver timely, role-specific enablement.

  • Support enterprise readiness during periods of change by ensuring leaders and staff understand new expectations and can continue executing effectively.

Adoption Reinforcement and Effectiveness Measurement (15%)

  • Track learning uptake, confidence, and effectiveness using participation data, feedback, and adoption signals.

  • Identify gaps in understanding or consistency and adjust learning approaches accordingly.

  • Partner with Product to align learning insights with roadmap decisions and adoption strategies.

Executive, Executive Assistant, and Special Assistant Enablement (10%)

  • Serve as a strategic thought partner to executives and their support teams, helping shape how digital systems and workflows should operate to support leadership execution.

  • Own the design and effectiveness of enterprise enablement services for executives, Executive Assistants, and Special Assistants, ensuring access to structured learning, clear guidance, and hands-on support delivered by the Digital Workplace team.

  • Ensure executive and assistant enablement aligns with enterprise standards while remaining responsive to real-world leadership needs.

About You

You have:

  • 5+ years of experience in enterprise learning, enablement, digital adoption, or related roles.

  • Experience designing learning for complex, distributed organizations.

  • A strong ability to translate tools, workflows, and standards into clear, practical learning experiences.

  • Experience supporting organizations through significant digital change or platform transitions.

  • A learner-centered mindset and strong instincts for adult learning and behavior change.

  • Comfort working cross-functionally with Product, Technology, Talent, and executive stakeholders.

  • Strong facilitation, communication, and influence skills.

  • The judgment to balance enterprise consistency with local adaptation.

  • A commitment to College Board's mission and to improving outcomes for students.

  • Ability to travel 2-4 times a year on behalf of College Board business

All positions at College Board require

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work.

  • Authorization to work in the United States for any employer.

  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions, and comfort learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.

  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal.

  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.

  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.

  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success.

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled.

  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes resume and application submission, a recruiter phone or video screen, a hiring manager interview, a performance exercise, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership, and reference checks.

About Our Benefits and Compensation

College Board offers a competitive benefits and compensation program that attracts top talent looking to make a difference in education. As a self-sustaining non-profit, we believe in compensating employees equitably in relation to each other, their qualifications, their impact, and the relevant market.

The hiring range for a new employee in this position is $80,000 to $135,000.College Board differentiates salaries by location, so where you live will narrow theportion of this range in which you can expect a salary.

Your salary will be carefully determined based on your location, relevant experience, the external labor market, and the pay of College Board employees in similar roles. College Board strives to provide our best offer up front based on this criteria.

Your salary is only one part of all that College Board offers, including but not limited to:

  • A comprehensive package designed to support the well-being of employees and their families and promote education. Our robust benefits package includes health, dental, and vision insurance, generous paid time off, paid parental leave, fertility benefits, pet insurance, tuition assistance, retirement benefits, and more.

  • Recognition of exceptional performance through annual bonuses, salary growth over time through market increases, and opportunities for merit raises and promotions based on increased scope of responsibility.

  • A job that matters, a team that cares, and a place to learn, innovate, and thrive.

You can expect to have transparent conversations about benefits and compensation with our recruiters throughout your application process.

Today, we offer bundled cash offers, mortgage, and title services in 13 states, enabling buyers and sellers to move with certainty and convenience.

We’re a fully remote company with a diverse team spread across several countries - Grounded in three core values: The Golden Rule, One Team One Dream, and Calm Focus. Hear from our employees about what our values mean to them.

About The Opportunity

We’re seeking an experienced Engineering Manager to lead our acquisition team engineers as we grow our Product & Tech team. The ideal candidate will have a history of leading their team(s) to deliver quality features and products in a timely manner, and they’ll bring their experience and skills to the table when it comes to scaling up our team and its processes.

  • Adapt the team's process as AI-assisted development changes how quickly work moves, and use metrics to make those calls
  • Coach team members as they take on greater skills and responsibilities
  • Work with product managers to understand requirements, prioritize backlogs, and set timelines

About You:

  • 2+ years of experience as a front-line manager in a high-growth organization
  • 7+ years of experience as an individual contributor
  • Demonstrable front-end or full-stack experience
  • A track record of adopting AI-assisted development on your team and turning it into real throughput – not just tool licenses

See more about how Homeward takes care of our team here.

THE GOLDEN RULE. It’s simple: Treat others the way we want to be treated. Whether we’re dealing with colleagues or customers, we don’t prioritize money or growth over people, and we practice empathy at every opportunity.

CALM FOCUS. We work in tech and build solutions for real estate. Both are fast-paced and stressful industries. But by focusing on the larger objective rather than rushing from one task to the next, we can create solutions our customers love.

ONE TEAM, ONE DREAM. Big problems require big solutions. We look at our customers’ experiences holistically and recognize that solving them requires collaboration across teams and our three affiliate companies — Homeward, Homeward Mortgage and Homeward Title.

jobs.excerpt: Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm.
jobs.description:
Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. We exist to ship it: production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores' founders' sister company, which absorbs the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, dependency mapping, validation, test generation, that traditional consulting bills human hours against. Forward-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract.

We put delivery dates in contracts and carry the overage risk ourselves. That only works if someone owns the delivery — scope, timeline, budget, and sprint execution and treats a slipping date as their problem, not a status-report line item. That someone is you.

As our Technical Project Manager, you'll run distributed engineering teams across India and three US time zones on customer engagements where the date is committed. You'll run the daily, sprint, and client cadences, translate fluently between engineering and business stakeholders, and push back on scope creep with data. Agents compress the repetitive engineering work, which makes delivery faster and makes your job sharper: shorter timelines leave no room for blockers that sit in a log for days. We're looking for the PM who gets things done who personally removes blockers, drives escalations to closure, and makes sure no risk reaches the client as a surprise.

This role is not for you if:

  • Your default is to forward messages between the client and engineering.
  • Your role has primarily been reporting and coordination without delivery ownership.
  • You've only facilitated agile ceremonies without driving delivery outcomes.
  • Sprint ownership and execution were largely driven by a Business Analyst or Product Owner in your previous roles.

What you will do

  • Build the project plan in Smartsheet from the Solutions Architect's scope of work, real dependencies, a defensible critical path, sprint boundaries overlaid on the timeline.
  • Track scope, hours, and budget in real time. Flag burn-rate risk early and push back on scope creep with numbers, not gut feel.
  • Maintain a live risk register. Spot risks before they become issues, surface the right ones to the client at the right time, and drive mitigation actively.
  • Maintain a live RAID log (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) and an action tracker with clear ownership, accountability, and timely closure.
  • Run crisp daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives that produce decisions, not discussions.
  • Remove sprint blockers personally. Chase the client-side data dependency, escalate the stuck cloud permission, redirect pulled resources don't let "waiting on" sit in a log for days.
  • Handle sprint-level risks in real time: reprioritize, descope, swap stories, or escalate before commitments slip.
  • Keep trackers honest. Action items have owners and dates; delays are visible and followed up on time.
  • Translate technical progress into business language for the customer, and business priorities into clear, estimable requirements for engineers.
  • Facilitate internal and external architecture reviews across India and three US time zones; document decisions and circulate them the same day.
  • Produce weekly customer status updates a senior business leader can absorb in 90 seconds — RAG colors backed by evidence, not sentiment.
  • Own customer escalations and drive them to resolution. Communicate status, risks, and decisions needed — proactively, not reactively.

In addition, the Product Manager is expected to leverage Artificial Intelligence (AI) and data‑driven techniques throughout the product lifecycle to accelerate discovery, improve decision‑making, and deliver innovative, responsible, and compliant AI‑enabled solutions. This includes leading AI‑related research, experimentation, prototyping, and the creation of high‑quality product and governance artifacts aligned to Origami Risk standards and applicable regulatory requirements.

Starting base pay for this role is between $120,000 and $145,000. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as transferable skills, work experience, business needs, training, location, and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • A Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science / Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics / Natural Language Processing (NLP), Information Systems or other related fields.
  • Bachelor’s degree is accepted if only candidate has 5 years of experience in the field.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in related roles or domain - specifically for QA-automation/testing or cybersecurity roles

How it works
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation:
Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $40/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio. - Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

As a Cloud Engineer on the Security team, you’ll help mature Included Health’s cloud security posture across primarily AWS environments, with consideration for GCP.   • Build security tooling in Python, Go, and Lambda for vulnerability management, alerting, PHI logging, and cloud security workflows.

jobs.description:
About the company:

In the coming decades, our world needs far more critical minerals including copper, lithium, and cobalt, to build electric infrastructure, vehicles, data centers, and electronics. The mining industry is making 10x fewer discoveries per dollar spent on exploration compared to 30 years ago because the easy-to-find, near surface deposits have largely been discovered.

KoBold is the leading scientific mineral exploration, mine development, and technology development company. Our goal is to turn mineral exploration into a repeatable science to discover the minerals the world needs—by integrating artificial intelligence, human intelligence, and new technology. Our multidisciplinary teams of data scientists, engineers, and geologists work together to build data systems, design new sensors, and establish industry-leading workflows to develop and test subsurface predictions on our exploration projects.

Our first discovery, Mingomba, is a high-grade copper deposit in Zambia, found after spending materially less than industry average. We are developing Mingomba with the same technical rigor that we apply to exploration. The Mingomba team brings together mine and processing engineers, geologists, data scientists, software engineers, and community, health & safety, construction, and operations specialists. By combining industry knowledge and cutting edge technology, we are developing Mingomba into a world class project that has safer and more predictable outcomes for ourselves, partners, and communities. It is expected to create thousands of good jobs for generations.

KoBold runs exploration programs in eight countries, all with the potential for another discovery.

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and strategic natural resources companies BHP and Mitsubishi.

About The Role:

In this role, you will develop state of the art instruments to collect data to guide our exploration programs. You will simulate, characterize, and calibrate sensor performance and design new data acquisition systems. Working with vendors and partners, you will build hardware and work with our operations staff to deploy it in the field.

With this sensor data and other data sources at KoBold, you will build models and apply a wide range of scientific computing, statistical, and physics-based methods to find places where there is evidence of ore-forming processes at work and to predict the locations of ore-grade mineralization in 2D and 3D. You will help build a worldwide dataset that underlies our exploration program, with careful attention to identifying and quantifying uncertainty in the data and in our predictions. You will be creating models and developing software to accelerate discovery of critical battery metals.

You will join an outstanding team of data scientists and engineers and will work closely with KoBold’s world-renowned geoscientists to incorporate our best understanding of the chemical and physical processes that create ore deposits. Working with your geoscience colleagues, you will identify new opportunities and technologies for geophysical data collection, create 2D and 3D geologic predictions, identify exploration targets, design field programs to collect data, and use that data to reduce the uncertainty in our predictions and guide the next phase of field work.

Ultimately, your role is to help KoBold make valuable discoveries by building and deploying next generation hardware and using data tools to solve scientific problems. As one of the early members of this team, you will help build these tools from the ground up.

Responsibilities of this position include:

Technical execution

  • Design, develop, and deploy new mineral exploration data collection instruments and methods.
  • Help develop KoBold’s proprietary software exploration tools.
  • Find and curate a wide variety of geospectral, geophysical, geochemical, geologic, and geographic data and integrate it into KoBold’s proprietary data system.
  • Build models to make statistically valid predictions about the locations of compositional anomalies within the Earth’s crust.
  • Create effective visualizations for evaluating model performance and enabling rapid interaction with the underlying data and key features.
  • Develop and apply a range of data processing, statistical, and physics-based techniques to geoscientific data — from computer vision to geophysical inversions — and use the results to guide our targeting efforts and inform our acquisition and exploration decisions.
  • Present to and collaborate with our external partners and stakeholders.
  • Push the state of the art in analysis capabilities by implementing statistically rigorous spatially aware clustering, anomaly detection, and other analysis methods
  • Collaborate with data scientists, geoscientists and engineers to invent and deploy algorithms that combine large and complex data sets for mineral exploration and discoveries

Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to quickly absorb and synthesize complex information, with a track record of high intellectual rigor in a professional setting.
  • Exceptional curiosity and eagerness to learn, with a proactive approach to exploring new concepts and technologies.
  • A successful track record of developing complex equipment with cross-disciplinary teams and vendors.

Technical skills, including extensive experience with:

  • Physical measurement and data analysis systems that use phenomena such as optics, electromagnetism, radiation, and gravity.
  • Applying scientific knowledge to identify and prototype emerging technologies
  • Systems integration and data acquisition.
  • Python’s data science packages and general software engineering practices.
  • Collaborative software development (git), and familiarity with software engineering best practices like unit test / integration test suites, and CICD pipelines.
  • SQL, as well as familiarity with non-relational databases.
  • Cloud computing resources.
  • Building a wide variety of predictive models, applying them to different problems, and evaluating and interpreting the results.
  • Data analysis, physics analysis, and applied statistics on a broad range of types of data including data from physical systems.
  • Capacity to dive deep on novel challenging problems in applying ML to mineral exploration, including understanding a complex domain of geology and mineral exploration practices as well as working with limited, disparate and noisy data sources
  • Experience deploying sensors in the field

Work practices and motivation:

  • Ability to take ownership and responsibility of large projects.
  • Intellectual curiosity and eagerness to learn about all aspects of mineral exploration, particularly in the geology domain. Open to working directly with geologists in the field. Enjoys constantly learning such that you are driving insights and innovations.
  • Ability to explain technical problems to and collaborate on solutions with domain experts who aren’t software developers. A strong communicator who enjoys working with colleagues across the company.
  • Excitement about joining a fast-growing early-stage company, comfort with a dynamic work environment, and eagerness to take on a range of responsibilities.
  • Keen not just to build cool technology, but to figure out what technical product to build to best achieve the business objectives of the company.
  • Ability to independently prioritize multiple tasks effectively.

It is also helpful but not required to have experience with:

  • Remote sensing
  • Creating machine learning models on geospatial data
  • Image processing or computer vision
  • Project and team management

What to Expect

Joining KoBold means getting the opportunity for hands-on exposure to our exploration projects around the world. All employees are expected to travel to project sites, with a minimum of one week per year. Field-facing and technical roles spend significantly more time in the field.

KoBold Metals is an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity for people of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, age, citizenship, disability, or veteran status.

This position is Full-time Exempt

Salary is one part of KoBold’s total compensation. The US salary range for this role is between $125,000 and $235,000, and will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. In addition to salary, we offer equity compensation. We also offer benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401k retirement plan, short & long term disability and life insurance. We also offer paid sick time and parental leave."

Location: Remote, Candidates can be located anywhere in the United States or Canada. All candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States or Canada. 10-20% travel required.

jobs.excerpt: HOSPITALITY Revenue & Distribution Analyst (Remote) Position SummarySandestin Golf & Beach Resort is seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Revenue & Distribution Analyst to support revenue optimization, distribution strategy, forecasting, and inventory management across the resort's diverse lodging portfolio.
jobs.description:
HOSPITALITY Revenue & Distribution Analyst (Remote)

Position Summary

Sandestin Golf & Beach Resort is seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Revenue & Distribution Analyst to support revenue optimization, distribution strategy, forecasting, and inventory management across the resort's diverse lodging portfolio. Must have hospitality experience as well as Opera proficiency.

This position is responsible for analyzing business trends, managing rates and inventory, maintaining distribution channels, supporting system implementations, and providing actionable insights that maximize occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, and profitability. The Revenue & Distribution Analyst will play a key role in ensuring accurate rate distribution, inventory management, forecasting, and channel performance across direct, group, wholesale, OTA, consortia, and travel advisor business segments.

The ideal candidate possesses a strong understanding of resort revenue management, distribution systems, pricing strategies, and hospitality technology platforms.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Revenue Analysis & Forecasting

  • Analyze daily, weekly, monthly, and annual booking pace, occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, and revenue performance.
  • Maintain accurate data on Rentals in the Sandestin program.
  • Monitor demand trends, market conditions, local events, and competitive activity.
  • Assist with forecasting, budgeting, and long-range demand planning.
  • Prepare and distribute recurring revenue reports and dashboards for leadership.
  • Identify revenue opportunities and provide recommendations to optimize performance.
  • Conduct variance analyses and communicate findings to stakeholders.

Rate & Inventory Management

  • Create, maintain, and audit transient, negotiated, wholesale, group, package, promotional, owner, and consortia rate plans.
  • Build and maintain corporate negotiated rates and contracted account pricing.
  • Manage inventory controls including:
    • Minimum Length of Stay (MLOS)
    • Closed to Arrival (CTA)
    • Closed to Departure (CTD)
    • Blackout dates
    • Availability restrictions
  • Conduct regular audits to ensure rate integrity and inventory accuracy across all systems.

Distribution & Connectivity Management

  • Manage and maintain distribution through:
    • Oracle Opera Cloud PMS
    • Springer Miller SMS|Host (during transition period)
    • SynXis CRS
    • WorldNXT Booking Engine
    • Sabre GDS
    • OTA and third-party distribution channels
  • Monitor channel connectivity and troubleshoot rate, inventory, and reservation discrepancies.
  • Ensure accurate mapping of rates, inventory, market segments, and restrictions across all distribution channels.
  • Conduct routine rate parity and channel audits.
  • Collaborate with vendors and internal stakeholders regarding distribution enhancements and connectivity issues.

OTA, Wholesale & Travel Advisor Management

  • Monitor performance and profitability of OTA channels including Expedia Group, Booking.com, Hotels.com, Airbnb, VRBO, and other third-party partners.
  • Analyze channel contribution, acquisition costs, cancellation trends, and net revenue.
  • Support strategies to maximize direct bookings while optimizing channel mix.
  • Maintain wholesale, consortia, travel advisor, and package offerings.
  • Assist in evaluating and implementing new distribution opportunities and partnerships.

Package & Promotional Strategy

  • Build and maintain promotional offers and package programs.
  • Manage package components including resort credits, golf inclusions, dining offers, activity packages, and seasonal promotions.
  • Audit package pricing, inclusions, and revenue recognition to ensure accuracy.
  • Evaluate promotional effectiveness and provide recommendations for future campaigns.

System Administration & Implementation Support

  • Support the resort's migration from SMS|Host to Opera Cloud.
  • Assist with system configuration, testing, validation, and training efforts.
  • Participate in user acceptance testing and implementation projects.
  • Document revenue management and distribution processes and procedures.

Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Partner with Sales, Reservations, Marketing, Finance, Front Office, Rental Management, and Operations teams.
  • Assist with group pricing analysis and displacement evaluations.
  • Support creation and maintenance of contracted group and negotiated rates.
  • Provide revenue insights and recommendations to support strategic business decisions.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, or related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.
  • Minimum two (2) years of experience in hospitality revenue management, reservations, distribution, revenue analysis, or related field.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills including pivot tables, lookups, reporting, and data analysis.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred

  • Experience with:
    • Oracle Opera Cloud PMS
    • Springer Miller SMS|Host
    • SynXis CRS
    • WorldNXT Booking Engine
    • Sabre GDS
    • Revenue management and distribution systems
  • Experience creating and maintaining:
    • Corporate negotiated rates
    • Consortia programs
    • Wholesale and tour operator rates
    • Group rates
    • Promotional and package offers
    • Travel advisor programs
    • GDS rate plans
  • Experience with OTA channel management and distribution.
  • Experience in a resort, vacation rental, condominium resort, or mixed-inventory hospitality environment strongly preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong understanding of hospitality revenue management principles.
  • Knowledge of distribution channels, GDS systems, OTA channels, and booking engine management.
  • Understanding of market segmentation, pricing strategies, and inventory controls.
  • Ability to analyze complex data and present actionable recommendations.
  • Strong systems aptitude and ability to troubleshoot distribution and connectivity issues.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Occupancy Growth
  • ADR Growth
  • RevPAR Growth
  • Forecast Accuracy
  • Rate Integrity
  • Distribution Channel Performance
  • Rate Parity Compliance
  • Inventory Accuracy
  • Reporting Accuracy and Timeliness
  • Successful System Implementation Support

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in person, by phone, and electronically.
  • Ability to occasionally attend meetings throughout the resort.

Sandestin Golf & Beach Resort is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace for all team members.

jobs.title: Physician Partner - Florida
jobs.excerpt: Papa is a new kind of care built on human connection.
jobs.description:
Papa is a new kind of care built on human connection. Across the country consumers, health plans, and employers look to Papa to provide vital social support by pairing older adults and families with Papa Pals. Trained and vetted companions who provide a helping hand and an open ear, resulting in less loneliness, better health, and happier lives.

Founded in 2017 due to Andrew's personal need with his grandfather, Papa. Based in Miami, Papa is backed by Canaan, Tiger Global Management, Comcast Ventures, SoftBank Vision, TCG, Initialized Capital, and Seven Seven Six, among other revered institutional and individual investors. We envision a world where no one has to go it alone. Learn more at Papa.com.

About us:

Papa Docs is a physician-led medical practice dedicated to advancing care for older adults by addressing both medical needs and the social factors that influence health. Our team provides virtual, compassionate, and evidence-informed care that integrates medical and social care delivery — meeting older adults where they are.

We serve Medicare beneficiaries through a physician-directed, community-based care navigation model. Physicians collaborate with trained Community Care Advocates who help older adults navigate local services, address gaps in social support, and improve overall well-being. This clinical model is designed to identify, assess, and manage both medical and social risks using scalable, tech-enabled workflows that are grounded in trust, dignity, and accessibility.

Papa Docs is supported by Papa Health, a wholly owned subsidiary of Papa, Inc., which provides non-clinical management and technology infrastructure. This alignment allows Papa Docs’ physicians to focus fully on patient care while ensuring that services are accessible, scalable, and grounded in community.

About the role:

We are seeking a mission-driven, collaborative Physician Partner to join Papa Docs by integrating health-related social needs (HRSNs) into care delivery. This is a high-impact opportunity to work at the intersection of clinical care and social support.

As a Physician Partner, you will provide synchronous and asynchronous telemedicine consultations for older adults, conduct virtual assessments, and generate care plans that address both medical and social needs. These care plans will be implemented and supported by Community Care Advocates. As one of the early physician partners, you'll have significant influence over how we deliver care and design our clinical workflows. If you've ever wanted to shape a clinical practice from the beginning rather than inherit someone else's playbook, this is that chance.

This is a part-time, remote, 1099 contractor position with flexible hours.

What you’ll do:

  • Conduct virtual visits with older adults and review their medical history
  • Identify health-related social needs (HRSNs) as part of the care planning process
  • Create and update care plans that guide Community Care Advocates in providing community health support services to patients
  • Participate in asynchronous chart reviews and escalations, as needed
  • Collaborate with Papa Docs’ partners, including operational teams to inform workflows
  • As one of our early physicians, your insights will contribute to shaping our workflows, refining our care model, and solving operational challenges in real-time. Your input will directly influence how we grow.

Skills we look for:

  • Excellent communication and clinical reasoning skills
  • Compassionate, patient-first mindset
  • Comfort working in a fast-moving, tech-enabled environment (experience with telemedicine is a plus)
  • Flexibility, reliability, and collaboration in cross-functional teams
  • Reliable independent contributor open to collaborating with operations to improve clinical workflows
  • Startup mindset - highly adaptable, communicative across operational and clinical teams, and see gaps as opportunities.

What you bring:

  • Active, unrestricted MD or DO license in good standing
  • Board certification in Geriatric Medicine, Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, or Preventive Medicine
  • Active state medical license in the U.S., (multiple state licensure is a plus)
  • Openness enrolling with Medicare and Medicaid, with the process and fees covered by Papa Docs
  • Minimum 2 years post-residency clinical experience
  • Prior experience with telemedicine strongly preferred
  • Flexibility to work a minimum of 8 hours/week for synchronous consultations on weekdays
  • Fluency in Spanish is a bonus

Location

  • Remote

Benefits:

  • Flexible remote schedule
  • Administrative support — so you can focus on patient care
  • As an independent contractor, you will be responsible for your own taxes and benefits

jobs.description:
Somos aliados do médico durante toda a sua jornada e buscamos por pessoas que se identifiquem com nosso propósito, valores e cultura para se juntarem ao nosso time. Vamos juntos transformar a saúde com quem tem a medicina como vocação!

Esta é uma vaga aberta na frente de Dados para trabalhar de formaremota.

Ao assumir o cargo de Engenheiro (a) de Marchine Learning Sr na Afya, seu objetivo principal será sustentar o ciclo de vida de ML clássico, dar suporte de plataforma à Ciência de Dados em GenAI, e garantir que tudo isso rode com governança e escalabilidade.

Você atuará na área de Dados dentro da diretoria de Tecnologia e fará parte de uma equipe multidisciplinar, relacionando-se no dia a dia com pessoas de times como Cientista de Dados, Engenharia de dados e SRE.

♿Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas a pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitadas do INSS.

💻🩺 COMO VOCÊ VAI TRANSFORMAR A SAÚDE NO DIA A DIA:

  • Sustentar o ciclo de vida completo dos modelos — feature engineering, treino, validação, registro e deploy.
  • Monitorar modelos em produção e conduzir retreinamento quando houver degradação de performance ou drift.
  • Manter e evoluir as esteiras de CI/CD que promovem modelos e pipelines entre ambientes (dev, hml, prod).
  • Automatizar e produtizar pipelines de avaliação (evals) de modelos e agentes, em apoio direto à Ciência de Dados. Construir e manter pacotes internos de métricas reutilizáveis, para experimentos avaliados de forma padronizada. Operar a infraestrutura de fine-tuning de modelos de linguagem. Administrar o AI Gateway — roteamento de modelos, rate limits, controle e atribuição de custo.
  • Garantir a governança de features, experimentos e modelos, sempre alinhada às políticas da Afya.
  • Atuar como ponte técnica entre Ciência de Dados, Engenharia de IA, Engenharia de Dados e SRE.
  • Aplicar práticas de escalabilidade, segurança e custo na infraestrutura de ML/IA sob sua responsabilidade.

🔎 O QUE BUSCAMOS (mas não esperamos que uma única pessoa atenda a todos os requisitos):

  • Databricks como plataforma principal, em nível de referência técnica: Model Serving, Unity Catalog e Asset Bundles, com MLflow para registro, versionamento e avaliação de modelos. Experiência equivalente em SageMaker, Vertex AI ou Azure ML conta, com disposição para se aprofundar em Databricks.
  • Python, SQL e Apache Spark / PySpark em nível avançado, aplicados a pipelines de Machine Learning em produção (scikit-learn, XGBoost).
  • CI/CD e infraestrutura como código para promover modelos e pipelines entre desenvolvimento, homologação e produção: GitHub Actions, Terraform (ou IaC equivalente), cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP) e gestão de segredos.
  • Operação de modelo em produção: promoção e rollback de versão (troca de alias e verificação pós-deploy), monitoramento de performance, custo e drift, e resposta a incidentes de endpoint — indisponibilidade, latência e queda de qualidade.
  • Leitura estatística de resultados de avaliação para decidir promoção ou reversão de versão, com governança dos experimentos, das versões de modelo e dos dados de inferência. Aqui essa decisão afeta produtos usados por milhares de médicos todo dia.
  • LLMOps na perspectiva de plataforma: exposição a pelo menos uma destas frentes — AI Gateway (roteamento multi-provedor e atribuição de custo), automação de pipelines de avaliação (evals) e pacotes internos de métricas reutilizáveis, ou infraestrutura de fine-tuning de LLMs.
  • Liderança técnica sênior, sem gestão de pessoas: definir a arquitetura da plataforma de ML, negociar contratos técnicos com Ciência de Dados, Engenharia de IA, Engenharia de Dados e SRE, e mentorar engenheiros plenos.

Proposal Architect responsibilities may be performed entirely within proposal development or in combination with client accounting work, skill alignment, and business needs. ImmunityBio is a vertically integrated commercial stage biotechnology company developing next-generation therapies that bolster the natural immune system to defeat cancers and infectious diseases. The Company’s range of immunotherapy and cell therapy platforms, alone and together, act to drive and sustain an immune response with the goal of creating durable and safe protection against disease. Designated an FDA Breakthrough Therapy, ANKTIVA is the first FDA-approved immunotherapy for non-muscle invasive bladder cancer CIS that activates NK cells, T cells, and memory T cells for a long-duration response.
